epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成為啫堡之王並非易事。嗯……是容易的。但國王認為應該更容易,所以他創造了自己的複製人,他能指揮他們在四處做所有艱苦的工作。不出所料,這些複製人就像國王一樣非常懶惰,不但沒有提供幫助,反而成為了啫堡一個日益嚴重的新問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being the King of Jammbo isnt an easy task. Well...yes it is. But the King believes it should even more easy, so he creates clones of himself that he can order around, having them do all the hard work. As expected, these clones, much like the King,a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡舉行了另一場有趣的比賽,每個孩子必須在渡渡鳥的幫助下,力所能及找到最大的音樂三葉草。比路遇到要協助他的渡渡鳥時感到吃虧。因牠是比路見過最老、最愛發牢騷的渡渡鳥。不過,比路很快就意識到,這隻特殊的渡渡鳥和他們之間的特殊關係,會帶來比他想像中多的驚喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another fun contest in Jammbo is celebrated, in which each child, with the help of a Dodo, must search for the largest musical clover he can find.Bello feels at a disadvantage when he meets the Dodo who will assist him. This Dodo is the oldest and th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王剛剛調整了他的汽車,所以想讓所有人都見到。這就是為何他組織了一場賽車比賽,啫堡上的所有車輛都將參加!甚至連莉塔和她的三輪車也參賽!比賽開始,國王不再自負,這說服孩子們需要聯合起來,全力以赴贏得勝利!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has just tuned his car and hes not willing for it to go unnoticed.Thats why hes organized a race in which all vehicles on Jammbo will compete! Even Rita with her tricycle! The race begins and the King sets his cockiness free, thus convinc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛的舊運動鞋終於破了,女王送給他一雙閃亮的新鞋。姑毛對新運動鞋那令人著迷的潔白感到非常驚訝,令他做不到任何事。問題是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑過泥濘或用它們踢球,還要它來幹嘛?姑毛是這麼想的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Goomos old sneakers finally break, the Queen gives him a new, shiny pair. Goomo is so taken back with the hypnotic whiteness of his new sneakers, that he is incapable of anything else. The question is...is it worth having sneakers if you cant

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻變森林」中散步時,發現了一隻離家出走的小渡渡鳥,在這個陌生地方迷了路。在救援行動中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要運用自己的聰敏才能找到小渡渡鳥,並回到朋友身邊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and the Queen take a walk thru the mysterious “changing forest” when they discovera baby Dodo who has strayed away from its parents and is lost in this strange place. During the rescue operation, Rita gets lost as well. She will need to apply he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜的一項實驗刺激到一隻渡渡蝶,使其長得非常巨大。一開始,牠嚇跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子們很快就會經歷一段美好而意想不到的友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of Minas experiments provokes a Dodo-Butterfly to grow at mammoth proportions. At the beginning, the animal scares away the people on Jammbo but the Dodo-Butterfly and the children, will soon experience a beautiful and unexpected friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們用舊蛇皮嚇唬朋友,結果卻發現當一條真正的蛇來襲時,被嚇到是多麼的「無趣」。/小麻決定使用小蟲子的萬聖節服裝來演一場恐怖劇,牠卻發現表演一場演出比想像費力得多。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids use an old snake skin to scare their friends only to discover how un-fun being frightened is when a real snake comes to call./ When Shimmer decides to use the little bugs’ Bug-a-boo Day costumes to stage a spooky play, she discovers that p

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬至到了,蟲子們必須做好事,以確保「夢蟲」在這個一年中夜晚最長的日子為牠們帶來許多好夢。/在匆匆趕回家過家庭歡樂節時,蜘蛛小姐、史角和蹦士被困在一場暴風雪中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s winter solstice and the bugs have to do their good deeds to make sure the “dream bug” brings them lots of good dreams on this longest night of the year./ While hustling home for the families Jolly Holly Day Fest, Miss Spider, Squirt and Bounce g

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers accompany an Indian peacock home to the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠在尋找一隻雲豹的媽媽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers go in search of a clouded leopards mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠到秘魯帶一隻叉拍尾蜂鳥回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to Peru to take a spatuletail home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠帶一隻野豬回到雨林的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers return a wild boar to its home in the forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去澳洲帶一隻黃腳岩袋鼠跟牠的孩子回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to Australia to take a yellow footed rock wallaby and her baby home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去稀樹草原帶一隻猴子回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers head to the Savannah to take a monkey home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去雨林帶一隻小葵花鳳頭鸚鵡回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to the rainforest to take a yellow crested cockatoo home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小遊俠去太平洋找一個珊瑚礁給條紋斑竹鯊居住。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers sail to the Pacific Ocean to find a coral reef for a white spotted bamboo shark to live.

epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #21
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一隻海象和疣豬到節目做秀。儘管牠倆的生活環境南轅北轍,但都擁有獠牙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Walrus and a Warthog to the show. Though they live in very different environments, both of these animals have tusks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #22
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #22
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一隻灰熊和刺蝟到節目做秀。牠倆都嗜睡並需要冬眠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Grizzly Bear and a Hedgehog to the show. Both of these animals get sleepy and need to hibernate.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #23
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #23
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一隻美國毒蜥和更格盧鼠到節目做秀。牠倆有共同的棲息地:沙漠!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Gila Monster and a Kangaroo Rat to the show. These animals share a habitat: the desert!

epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #24
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎一隻大角羊和歐洲馬鹿到節目做秀。牠倆都有角。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Bighorn Sheep and a Red Deer to the show. Both of these animals have horns or antlers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路和姑毛夢想成為真正的超級英雄,所以他們請米娜訓練他們。她恰如其分,只是比路還沒有準備好忍受漫長而艱苦的訓練。他放棄並選擇了一項更容易的活動。那是他以後會後悔的事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo dream of becoming real super heroes so they ask Mina to train them.She sets out to do a great jobbut Bello isnt ready to endure the long and hard training. He gives up and choses an easier activity. Something he will later regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當其他人都得到讚揚和掌聲時,要站著面對並不總是那麼容易。比路嘗試在他朋友的表演中搶盡風頭,讓他們非常沮喪,比路需要分享他的一些才能來解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It´s not always easy to stand still when everyone else gets praise and applause. Bello will try to steal the show during his friends performances. They get so upset that Bello will need to share some of his talent to fix things.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers travel to the forest to return an equatorial spitting cobra to its home.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers adventure to the rainforest to return a green iguana home.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about China and the marvellous unique animals that you find there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物進食的不同方式。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the different ways that animals eat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集我們將看看所有那些看起來很可愛但絕對不可愛的大型美麗動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode we’re taking a look at all those big beautiful animals that look cute but definitely not cuddly.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about animals that are our best friends our helpers our companions and our sidekicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about wings.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five mothers of the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查克和狐猴倒數動物界父親的頭五位。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chuck and Lemur count down the top five animal dads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛認為比路是他最好的朋友。不過,比路也是這樣想嗎?姑毛開始考驗他們的友誼,但不斷的考驗卻適得其反,令雙方都不開心,他們去和「其他朋友」一起玩,但他們發現沒有人比你的死黨更有趣,也更瞭解你的特性。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩記得母親關於交好朋友的建議。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho remembers his mothers advice about having good friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識大白鯊-所有鯊魚中的美人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the great white shark - Pin-up of all the sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍先生今天免費讓小孩們乘坐!只有一個簡單規矩。不過,這規則把小孩們的開心計劃搞得一團糟!他們能和平共處並享受旅程嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Dragon is offering free rides to children today! He just has one simple rule.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們未經許可進入太空船的一間房,令一個外星人成功逃走。他們必須在太空人先生發現前找到外星人,並將牠送回原先的房間。不過,這外星人真的很善於躲藏!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children enter a room on the Spaceship without permission and an alien runs loose. They have to find the alien and return it to where it belongs before Mr. Astronaut finds out. However, this alien is really good at hiding!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空人先生忙於執行任務,小孩們被委派照料阿斯翠。在太空站一起玩樂時,「阿斯翠」開始表現出一些有趣和不尋常的行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are tasked to baby sit Astrid while Mr. Astronaut is busy with a mission. While having fun together in the Space Station, Astrid starts to display some interesting and unusual behaviour.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們很期待看流星雨,卻很難找到能看到流星雨的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are really looking forward to watching the meteor shower, but they have trouble finding a place with a good view of it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園侏儒先生指派小孩們照料一朵非常珍貴的花,它不像他們見過的任何花卉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are tasked by Mr. Garden Gnome to care for a very precious flower that isnt like any other flowers theyve ever seen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與寶拉和她的朋友們一起找出是誰織了一條毀了整個地方的頸巾。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Paula and her friends to find out whos responsible for knitting a scarf thats ruining the entire place.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園侏儒先生失去了他的魔力。小孩們助他不用魔法也能過活。花園侏儒先生會取回他的魔法嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Garden Gnome lost his magical powers. The children help him get through everyday life without magic. Will Mr. Garden Gnome ever get his magic back?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們組成了一隊搖滾樂隊,他們受邀在叢林搖滾音樂會上進行首場演出。但他們在路上盡是遇到一些小麻煩。他們怎樣才能確保不會錯過表演的機會?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children form a rock band and theyre invited to play their first gig at the Jungle Rock Concert. But they run into some monkey trouble along the way. What will the children do to ensure they dont miss their chance to perform?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園侏儒先生把噴嚏打到鑿奇身上,並把自己一部分魔力轉移給他,到底之後會發生甚麼事?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What happens when Mr. Garden Gnome sneezes onto Chalky and transfers some of his magical powers to him?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯芬克斯叔叔、商人先生和阿米爾之間因溝通不當而鬧出不快。孩子們必須弄清楚發生甚麼事,並幫每個人解決問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s a miscommunication between Uncle Sphinx, Mr. Merchant and Aamil that causes some unhappiness. The children have to figure out what happened and help straighten things out with each person.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 數隻遷徙的螃蟹霸了沉船作為新家園,令紅鬍子十分沮喪。 小孩們必須幫紅鬍子和莫里斯趕走牠們。他們會怎樣做?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Several migrating crabs claim the Shipwreck as their new home, much to Redbeards dismay. The children have to help Redbeard and Maurice chase them away. How will they do it?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊戲室的燈熄滅了。伸手不見五指很是可怕,但小孩們知道一根有著永恆之光的蠟燭!要取得它的話,他們必須面對恐懼,並進入前所未見最黑暗的洞穴!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lights in the playroom go out. Being in the dark is scary, but the children learn about a candle with an everlasting light! To retrieve it, they have to face their fears and enter the darkest cave ever!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拔迪先生似乎總是很暴躁。小孩們想出一個讓拔迪先生眉開眼笑的計劃,但卻事與願違。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Buddy always seems to be very cranky. The children come up with a plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫里斯不小心把紅鬍子的鐵鈎弄彎了。小孩們幫紅鬍子找到一些相當獨特的代鈎,但紅鬍子懷疑它們有多實用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Maurice accidentally bends Redbeards hook out of shape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探險家先生找到一張地圖,上面有通往獎勵密室的線索,但他毫無頭緒。小孩們渴望幫探險家先生破解線索,並找出密室裡有甚麼獎勵等待著他們。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Explorer finds a map with clues leading to a secret chamber of rewards.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們在金銀島尋找黃金茉莉花。不過紅鬍子船長打算先下手為強!他會成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children go in search of the Golden Jasmine Flower on Treasure Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍先生今天免費讓小孩們乘坐!只有一個簡單規矩。不過,這規則把小孩們的開心計劃搞得一團糟!他們能和平共處並享受旅程嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Dragon is offering free rides to children today! He just has one simple rule.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們未經許可進入太空船的一間房,令一個外星人成功逃走。他們必須在太空人先生發現前找到外星人,並將牠送回原先的房間。不過,這外星人真的很善於躲藏!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children enter a room on the Spaceship without permission and an alien runs loose. They have to find the alien and return it to where it belongs before Mr. Astronaut finds out. However, this alien is really good at hiding!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太空人先生忙於執行任務,小孩們被委派照料阿斯翠。在太空站一起玩樂時,「阿斯翠」開始表現出一些有趣和不尋常的行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are tasked to baby sit Astrid while Mr. Astronaut is busy with a mission. While having fun together in the Space Station, Astrid starts to display some interesting and unusual behaviour.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們很期待看流星雨,卻很難找到能看到流星雨的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children are really looking forward to watching the meteor shower, but they have trouble finding a place with a good view of it.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國加州Ojai鎮流傳著一處神秘的「惡魔漩渦」,據說凡是踏入其禁地的人,都將被黑暗力量吞噬。六段彼此交織的恐怖故事,逐步揭開這股邪惡力量的真相,以及一棟遭受詛咒的房屋與歷代住戶無法逃離的駭人命運。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ojai, California, a mysterious spiritual vortex is said to unleash dark forces upon anyone who enters its domain. Through six interconnected horror tales, the terrifying secrets of a cursed house and its doomed inhabitants are revealed, exposing the sinister power lurking behind the Devils Vortex.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬來西亞一座與世隔絕的高原高科技療養院內,Jeghan博士秘密利用三名窮凶極惡的連環殺手進行人體生化改造實驗。豈料實驗失控,三人變異成毫無痛覺、殺戮本能全面覺醒的怪物,血洗實驗室後逃入叢林,恐怖殺戮自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At a secluded high-tech asylum hidden in the Malaysian highlands, Dr Jeghan secretly conducts biogenetic experiments on three notorious serial killers. When the experiment goes horribly wrong, the mutated killers escape into the jungle as ruthless, pain-free predators, unleashing an unstoppable wave of terror and bloodshed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: At a secluded high-tech asylum hidden in the Malaysian highlands, Dr Jeghan secretly conducts biogenetic experiments on three notorious serial killers. When the experiment goes horribly wrong, the mutated killers escape into the jungle as ruthless, pain-free predators, unleashing an unstoppable wave of terror and bloodshed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝毅忠年少時跳童請神,請來的竟是大伯爺白無常,釀成一場無法挽回的悲劇,自此再也不敢請神。多年後重返故鄉,村中詭異怪事接連發生,至親性命危在旦夕。面對邪靈作祟,他能否再次請神出煞,化解這場生死劫難?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a boy, Xie Yi Zhong performed a spirit-summoning ritual and accidentally invoked Bai Wu Chang, the White Reaper, triggering a tragedy. Years later, he returns home to find his hometown plagued by eerie events and his loved ones lives at stake. Will he dare summon the spirit again to confront the evil forces?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。淩晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失憶青年馬可醒來時,驚覺自己被囚禁在一棟廢棄舊屋,四周屍橫遍地。在密閉空間內,他被迫按照神秘幕後黑手的指示,逐一播放隨身碟中的十段詭異錄像。隨著致命詛咒接連降臨,他不僅陷入恐怖幻覺,身體更逐漸異變,記..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amnesiac Marco awakens imprisoned in an abandoned house surrounded by corpses. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
民國年間,江南村落接連發生離奇命案,逐漸淪為遠近聞名的鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與員警萬楓為追查一宗滅門慘案,深入陰森村莊抽絲剝繭,
誓要揭開連環命案背後的真相,破除流傳已久的封建迷信。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 副警長James奉命看守一具曾舉行神秘儀式的女屍。豈料,他因一時好奇誤觸未完成的邪惡儀式,讓禁忌之門大開,釋放出三個黑暗惡魔。在精神廢墟、幻覺與真實邪祟的瘋狂夾擊下,他的理智逐步瓦解,最終墜入無法逃離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

Thirteen years later, the site is now a university, and they reunite. When supernatural murders begin and a ghostly figure resembling Nu Aon appears, they are forced back into a deadly game of hide-and-seek.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An architect discovers his late father, who was Hitlers financial advisor, left behind a massive hidden fortune intended to make amends, but he becomes targets for neo-Nazis and conspirators.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on the Marvel Comics character, stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze gives up his soul to become a hell-blazing vigilante, to fight against power-hungry Blackheart, the son of the devil himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a covert mission goes wrong, a soldier escapes—leaving his best friend in enemy hands. A year later, he risks it all on a pulse-pounding rogue rescue! Thomas Ian Griffith stars in this explosive, adrenaline-fueled tale of ultimate loyalty.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bored married couple discovers they are both elite assassins working for competing agencies—and their next assignment is to eliminate each other. Marriage counseling just got explosive.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clans disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score The Proud One. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clans leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉.最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力,於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城.在途中,他們遇到了一名神秘俠客,三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪,竭力保護黃金不被劫走.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖回到中原時,遇上黃蓉,二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河.豈料,同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親.於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿,對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻.經過一輪激戰,郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克,奪得美人歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huangs father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally bea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝時代,書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義,誤殺總督之子,被迫逃亡.走投無路時,他逃至江畔,幸得漁夫之女相救.二人在險境中情愫暗生,玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物,締結終身之約.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由三個單元故事組成,為岳楓、程剛及張徹聯合執導,當年就有「花一張票價,看三套電影」的稱譽.嶽楓之〈鐵弓緣〉講述一對青年男女因一把鐵弓而結緣、程剛之〈胭脂虎〉講述一群絕色妓女的故事、張徹之〈白水灘〉講述梁山英雄後代的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏,兩人情投意合並私訂終身.婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害.最終在道士相助下,方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻,然而人鬼殊途,兩人於晨光中淒然訣別,冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者,高明說出乃黑豹所為後,即被開槍殺死,鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年.他出獄後即找黑豹報仇,卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾;同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫,欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落,但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名,從未見其人,究竟黑豹是誰?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - Black Leopard. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real ide

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美.但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇,三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可,被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲.三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象,他們的追女橋段層出不窮,用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方,卻全部失靈,烏龍百出...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺.事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九.其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇.五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為少林五祖.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奸相秦檜偽造十二道金牌,密謀強召抗金前線的岳飛退兵.華山俠士苗龍為救國運,率江湖義士沿途設卡攔截金牌.不料護送金牌的爪牙首領竟是其恩師金彥堂,令苗龍陷入忠義兩難.最終師徒在客棧反目血戰,苗龍雖拚死奪下金牌,卻仍難挽回歷史的千古遺憾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the wars front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two cl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將;一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞,蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴.後苗寨旱災,蛇王子答應率蛇作法,引水入寨,但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years.  All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sen

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續.七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家,奉命征討宦官專權.展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a sequel to Chang Chehs epic The Water Margin, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道,住客大多是各行各業的小市民.他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言兩語,道出人情冷暖,有道是:言為心聲.不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機,他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好,都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. Howeve

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰.太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手.七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭.玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦.秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻.誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才.可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she disc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦.秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻.誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才.可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she disc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貧寒書生張珍投奔相府,卻遭嫌貧愛富的準岳父冷落.碧波潭鯉魚精同情他的遭遇,化身相國千金,深夜與張珍相會,兩人漸生情愫.此事引發「真假千金」鬧相府的風波,更招來張天師降妖圍剿.面對天兵天將,張珍誓死不離,最終感動觀音,令鯉魚精化為凡人,與張珍終成眷屬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellors family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellors daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daught

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局掌門義子.司馬秋利慾薰心,設計弒殺師父,更以暗鏢毀去夏梧面容.重傷的夏梧懷抱年幼長女逃走,懷孕妻子卻於昏迷中遭司馬秋姦污.夏梧隱居深山,將仇恨寄託長女青青,苦心培育其成為武藝高強的「玉面飛狐」,命她下山劫鏢尋仇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daught

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗娘子被邪惡的黑金剛擊敗後,隱居多年,處心積慮要復仇.女俠翠屏勇猛堅毅,為剷除黑金剛,懇求鍾馗娘子收她為徒.娘子與翠屏兩師徒聯手對付黑金剛,也是他大限將至的時侯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子.從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法.最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗.當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復.幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救.兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, H

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編.故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合.然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十萬鏢銀被持神鞭作武器的劫鏢者劫去.因神鞭是有「影子神鞭」之稱的武林大師方承天的招牌武器,所以他的嫌疑最大,也因此引來連番追捕.自此以後,方消聲匿跡.十五年後,年輕女子楊寒雲突然出現,更拿著與當年一樣的神鞭.究竟這位女子是誰?「影子神鞭」的下落又如何?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master Shadow Whip, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬騰是雍正的密令組織「血滴子特務團」的其中一位殺手.當馬騰質疑其特務行動是否有違道義時,卻旋即變成被同伴追捕的逃犯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ma Teng is an assassin of the Flying Guillotine Squad, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯.白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍.兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密.珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方.五毒教的蛇壇主,要找出天羅所在,獨霸武林,誤放消息,謂天羅已重現武林,江湖一片風聲鶴唳…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called Five Poison Web, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方.五毒教的蛇壇主,要找出天羅所在,獨霸武林,誤放消息,謂天羅已重現武林,江湖一片風聲鶴唳…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called Five Poison Web, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事.於是二人不惜假裝自殺.有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚.此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announ

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,某寺青年僧人「瘋子」,性格瘋瘋癲癲,行為全不符僧人規範.該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣,並因應其性格與氣質,授以「癲羅漢拳」.「瘋子」有了武功後,動輒出拳傷人,方丈只得將其逐出寺門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his Crazy Lo Han Fist improves with every fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負,搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」.然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉,二人及後結成夫婦.郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,將其迷奸.良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厲鬼,將中元、良金等人殺害.玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一陣辛酸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片講述唐僧、孫悟空、豬八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取經,行至西梁女兒國,國內全是女人,而傳宗接代生兒育女全靠「招胎泉」,飲過這泉水便可成孕,但也只能生女.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易,庶室程夫人既憤且惱,對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥,催促二人早日成親.居易見雪雁貌醜而癡,嚇得留書出走.富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久,趁此良機冒充居易,依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角,配搭新鮮;而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出,更令人笑破肚皮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares hi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,民初北方軍閥混戰,民不聊生,紛紛向南逃難,三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生,夾在難民群中,來到戰區邊沿.王因出手營救一女難民,致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕,幸得風塵女子紅菱所救……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town wh

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 男孩小吉的父母離異後,希望尋找快樂的人生.一天,小吉喜遇好心鬼簡人,並結成好友.好心鬼決定要幫助小吉的父母復合,令小吉得到真正的快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居,遙對窗中倩影,而不相見,直至發生危機,小李才露面相告,並且挺身赴難.有不少高手為爭武林排名而找小李決鬥,小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰,於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助,但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷,簡直變成廢人,小李於是揭破這女人的假面目,並且設法使阿飛振作起來
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才.同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身.聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿.不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中.蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐僧師徒西行取經,受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山,唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火.然而因紅孩兒一事,牛魔王夫婦拒不相助.孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量.越過火焰山後,師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套.面對詭計多端的妖精,悟空再施神通,護師脫險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表.全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddhas Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him!  Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上.但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她.畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親.皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林名門世家子弟袁鷹飛為了對付虎威鏢局少鏢頭關雲,拉攏四位失意江湖高手對付他.豈料四人與關雲不打不相識,反成好友.後袁鷹飛設下毒計害死關雲,四人悲憤交集,遂聯手為友復仇.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本,意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽.二人見面後即墜入愛河,卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵.最後誰會得到巨鑽?二人的戀情又會否無疾而終?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sings wife and casts an evil love spell on

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭,插翅虎及活閻王,的武功,他們必定獨霸武林,江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨.活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟,決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎.究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞?誰可挽救一場武林浩劫?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld Kings sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力,並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影的一員。為替姐姐報仇,英加入魅影特工隊,接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中..

When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,水派幻術師裴靜之為搶奪法寶大開殺戒,最終被火派幻術師空空封印,之後空空帶著一孤兒卓非凡離開。二十年後,裴解開封印想再次奪寶,將空空殺害。空空死前將自己撫養的卓託付給落霞飛學習火術。卓發誓要為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dreaming of becoming a legendary swordsman, young Yu Dayou is drawn into a deadly conflict over a mythical sword and uncovers a conspiracy between coastal pirates and foreign invaders. After losing his master and comrades, he rises through hardship to defend his nation, avenge his master, and fulfil his heroic destiny.

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a man to join the army on behalf of her elderly father. She fights gallantly and vanquishes her enemies in rounds of battles. While they celebrate their victory, the enemy sets millions of rats into the city, followed by a raid. Mulan fearlessly defends the city, risking her life to ensure the peoples safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

When street hustler Lu Lan impersonates the infamous marksman to make a living, he is captured by the organisation’s deadliest assassin and drawn into a deadly conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yans name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王生偶然救了狐妖香兒,在不知香兒真實身分的情況下將她收留在家中,並對她心生愛慕,甚至想納她為妾。原來香兒也是被巫山老妖所控制,操縱她在人間作惡害人。王生和香兒最後能否走在一起,人和妖又能否相戀?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著一檔真人冒險節目展開,幾位不同背景的陌生人聚集在鱷夢島上。據說這個海島不僅景色宜人,還藏著一枚價值連城的金蛋,參加者要共同完成島上的冒險以嬴取最終大獎。然而,他們卻都在懵懂中成了犧牲品,因為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,大巫祭率領暗黑一族侵襲人族,戰神張赤炎不惜犧牲自己喚醒戰神劍,才得以擊退暗黑族。如今黑暗力量再次蘇醒,蠢蠢欲動,戰神之子張珂與及雲柃、福喜再次踏上喚醒戰神劍的旅程,而張珂也在戰鬥中成長為新戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the mysterious descendant of the Zhang family, Zhang Qi Shan, encounters the martial arts expert Er Yue Hong in Changsha, the two young heroes become acquainted and team up to confront the ruthless warlord Zuo Qian Zhi. They also uncover the truth behind the rumoured monster, and protect the safety of the people of Changsha together.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群年輕的大學生策劃了一場特殊的畢業旅行,然而卻陰差陽錯闖入了一座巨獸棲息的禁忌之島。因為人類的失誤,這個島成為了怪獸樂園,學生們要戰勝巨獸才能逃出生天。而隨著深入探索,他們發現這次畢業旅行背後,似乎..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭,最終被打回原形,天尊把他貶為凡人,及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後,蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒,他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟,二人情愫漸生,而..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風暴安保公司猛虎小隊負責安保及營救工作。小隊接到新任務,受到國際和平基金會僱傭,護送一輛裝滿水源淨化器和大量農作物種子的卡車前往薩基亞村落進行民間救援。可當地遭遇無政府組織入侵,途經區域處於戰火地帶。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu finds himself trapped inside an iron box after awaking from a coma. As the box opens, he finds himself in a tropical forest together with other survivors, all not knowing how they ended up there. Not only do they have to face various crisis and attacks from beasts, they also have to uncover the truth behind it all so as to escape from danger.

Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

While they celebrate their victory, the enemy sets millions of rats into the city, followed by a raid. Mulan fearlessly defends the city, risking her life to ensure the peoples safety.

While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?
