epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Qing dynasty, people are suffering from destitution. A divine omen and death of some ministers have sparked rumours of Qings downfall. Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天爺是江城最大的毒梟,行事謹慎,從不親自參與交易。平江市公安局禁毒大隊的大隊長陳昌榮為了抓住天爺,自願成為臥底進入天爺的販毒團夥,終極對決一觸即發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Tien, the most powerful drug dealer in Jiang City, is always on the alert and never gets involved in any drug trafficking personally. To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在香港讀書的少年葉問,意外卷入英國斯塔克集團綁架中國婦女走私到海外的人口販賣案中。葉挺身而出怒打綁匪解救出一批被拐的女子,不料遭到激烈報覆,更連累了身邊的朋友。葉問開始反思,知道個人力量不足夠對抗斯塔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dreaming of becoming a legendary swordsman, young Yu Dayou is drawn into a deadly conflict over a mythical sword and uncovers a conspiracy between coastal pirates and foreign invaders. After losing his master and comrades, he rises through hardship to defend his nation, avenge his master, and fulfil his heroic destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The head of a major cosmetics company experiments on herself with a youth formula made from royal jelly extracted from wasps, but the formula's side effects have deadly consequences.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The head of a major cosmetics company experiments on herself with a youth formula made from royal jelly extracted from wasps, but the formula's side effects have deadly consequences.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Seymour works in a skid row florist shop and is in love with his beautiful co-worker, Audrey. He creates a new plant that not only talks but cannot survive without human flesh and blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Young Jim Hawkins finds himself serving with pirate captain Long John Silver in search of a buccaneer's treasure, in this short adaptation of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Jim Hawkins finds himself serving with pirate captain Long John Silver in search of a buccaneer's treasure, in this short adaptation of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A scientific team in Mexico discover a pool of unusual baby "octopus-like" specimens. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Erin,一名飽受創傷與怒火困擾的女子,前往偏遠莊園探訪男友的家人,卻發現對方竟是操控血腥交易的邪教。當她被擄並成為獵物時,壓抑已久的怒火徹底爆發,反轉局勢,展開一場殘酷的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Erin, a troubled young woman with trauma and anger, travels to a remote estate to meet her boyfriend’s family. The visit turns into a nightmare when she discovers they are part of a blood cult. Abducted and marked for harvest, Erin unleashes a deadly rage, turning the hunt into a brutal fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪傑武松因揭發嫂子潘金蓮與西門慶的奸情而遭陷害,被迫刺配流放。當得知兄長武大郎慘遭毒殺後,武松悲憤回鄉討回公道,卻發現官府貪贓枉法,拒絕嚴懲真兇。面對黑白顛倒的世道,怒火中燒的武松決意血戰獅子樓,親手..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of grisly murders deep in the forest, where disturbing evidence points to the legendary “Beast”. As the body count rises, they uncover a chilling link between the killings and an ancient local legend, while a terrifying truth hidden deep within the woods slowly comes to light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!在這一集中,菲律賓演員、模特和游泳選手Enchong Dee與名人好友Ria將在香港展開上山下海的旅程,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and  his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天才拳擊手徐佳陽為了替父親還賭債在地下酒館打黑拳時被舉報,痛失奧運資格賽,隕落拳壇。十年後,鐵血教練陳麗月決要助她實現父親的遺願,重回拳壇找回昔日的自己。當拳擊的熱血碰上責任時,曾經失落的拳擊夢能否再..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the world is plunged into eternal darkness, adventurer Xiao Wu sets out to find a sealed ancient book that controls the universe. Betrayed by ruthless factions, he discovers he is a reincarnated magical page bound by an ancient love. Awakening his hidden powers, he battles evil to restore light and fulfil his destiny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命之樹被燒毀後,世間陷入一片混沌。為拯救蒼生,孫悟空決定回到過去,幫助生命之樹復活。因為失去了金箍棒,孫悟空力量時有時無,只得找回兒時的自己,一同前往尋找時間之力。不料,六耳獼猴卻想據為己有,兩人就..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當天才駭客Tara試圖阻止一個擁有自我意識的強大人工智能接管全球軍事系統時,她反被人工智能定性為必須剷除的恐怖分子……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the worlds military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三名持槍劫匪搶劫了一批正在運送的新發行貨幣,刑警常勇奉命展開調查。隨著線索逐漸浮現,常勇成功擊斃一名劫匪。然而,其他兩名劫匪不甘就此罷手,乘亂密謀搶劫金廠的黃金。常勇憑藉精密的部署,成功粉碎了他們的計..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命之樹被燒毀後,世間陷入一片混沌。為拯救蒼生,孫悟空決定回到過去,幫助生命之樹復活。因為失去了金箍棒,孫悟空力量時有時無,只得找回兒時的自己,一同前往尋找時間之力。不料,六耳獼猴卻想據為己有,兩人就..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當天才駭客Tara試圖阻止一個擁有自我意識的強大人工智能接管全球軍事系統時,她反被人工智能定性為必須剷除的恐怖分子……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the worlds military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三名持槍劫匪搶劫了一批正在運送的新發行貨幣,刑警常勇奉命展開調查。隨著線索逐漸浮現,常勇成功擊斃一名劫匪。然而,其他兩名劫匪不甘就此罷手,乘亂密謀搶劫金廠的黃金。常勇憑藉精密的部署,成功粉碎了他們的計..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個文明崩塌的末日廢土上,賞金獵人Dante靠著格鬥與追蹤求生。一次任務中,他意外掌握關乎世界走向的黑暗機密,觸動統治階層利益,遭軍事組織追殺滅口。走投無路的Dante利用礦洞地形,將追兵誘入死胡同..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, bounty hunter Dante survives on his fighting and tracking skills. During a mission, he uncovers a secret threatening the ruling elite, drawing a deadly manhunt. Cornered, Dante lures his pursuers into an abandoned mine and strikes back, leading survivors to the last untouched land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在多年前的一次反恐任務中,前特警隊長東谷被悍匪炸瞎雙眼,被迫退役,從此與女兒相依為命。不料,昔日宿敵再度現身,綁走其女,欲將她賣入地下人口販賣集團。這位失明的法外獨行俠,憑藉過人的聽覺與格鬥本領,隻身..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Blinded on a counter-terrorism mission, former SWAT captain Dong Gu retires and lives with his daughter. When his old nemesis resurfaces and kidnaps her for an underground trafficking ring, Dong Gu must rely on his heightened hearing and formidable combat skills to hunt down the criminals and rescue his daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘女拳手Koy在泰拳比賽中慘遭擊倒,竟墜入內心深處的恐懼與痛苦之中,並喚醒一片超現實夢境。在一名神秘男子的步步引導下,她必須憑藉傳統古泰拳的千鈞爆發力,隻身對抗層出不窮的幻覺與心魔,挑戰潛藏於內心深..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being defeated in a championship match, Muay Thai fighter Koy awakens in a surreal dreamscape shaped by her fears. Guided by a mysterious man, she must master Korat-style Muay Thai to battle violent illusions and buried trauma. As darkness closes in, Koy fights to reclaim her true identity and survive the ultimate test within her mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警探張荼為救落入人販之手的兒子,不惜孤身深入敵穴,跨國追擊,但卻被牽扯進大型兒童拐賣案。在尋找兒子的過程中,他和身份神秘的女子攜手搗毀了一個大型國際犯罪集團,上演了一場驚心動魄的絕地生死營救。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警校生阿山奉命臥底監獄,接近犯罪集團二把手阿天,暗中搜集其犯罪證據。阿天出獄後,阿山協助他以鐵血手段一路廝殺,最終登上社團話事人之位。然而,阿山頻繁與警方接觸的行跡逐漸敗露,臥底身份被社團識破,瞬間陷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法蘭克與女友到中東旅行時,女友慘遭殺害,他更被誣陷為兇手入獄。在死牢中結識一名獄友,並在對方暗中協助下策劃越獄,誓要揭開真相,將真正的兇手繩之以法。然而,唯一的盟友卻在行動前夕離奇身亡,法蘭克唯有孤注..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed during a tragic trip to the Middle East. Imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, he befriends a fellow inmate who helps him plot a daring escape to prove his innocence. However, when his only ally suddenly dies, Frank must risk everything to escape and uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 萊咖國政權交替之際,黑幫頭目宋邦企圖以政治獻金收買部長,競逐市長之位洗白勢力。為籌鉅款並剷除對手,他派出鄭吒與神秘打手蘇萬。鄭吒臥底身份不幸曝光,遭貪腐上司陷害,殉職前將未完使命託付蘇萬。面對層層陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A triad boss seeks to clean up his image and win the mayoral seat amid a regime change. To raise funds and eliminate rivals, he sends Zheng Zha and Su Wan into action. When Zheng Zha’s undercover identity is exposed, he is killed by a corrupt superior, entrusting his mission to the mysterious Su Wan, who takes up the cause and seeks revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景設定在2050年,世界被污染與瘟疫吞噬的末世。兩名偵探在調查一連串離奇命案時,揭開了一個由邪教組織與致命忍者聯手編織的黑暗陰謀。面對隱藏在迷霧中的強大敵手,他們必須爭分奪秒,在社會徹底崩潰前阻..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金牌保鏢龍威在妻子慘死後患上了創傷後應激障礙,心情低落。他意外結識高科技公司職員Amy,在她邀請下參加了新產品的虛擬測試。龍威測試成功後即成為該公司的虛擬特攻,更獲試用新發明的防護機甲,不料遭遇神秘武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

When Zheng Zha’s undercover identity is exposed, he is killed by a corrupt superior, entrusting his mission to the mysterious Su Wan, who takes up the cause and seeks revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in a dystopian 2050, two detectives investigate a string of mysterious murders in a world choked by pollution and pandemics. They soon discover a sinister cult and a deadly ninja assassin behind the carnage, forcing them into a desperate battle to save what remains of society.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金牌保鏢龍威在妻子慘死後患上了創傷後應激障礙,心情低落。他意外結識高科技公司職員Amy,在她邀請下參加了新產品的虛擬測試。龍威測試成功後即成為該公司的虛擬特攻,更獲試用新發明的防護機甲,不料遭遇神秘武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

When the sheriff puts a bounty on her head and mobilizes local militia to hunt her down, Megan and her companions must fight through the wilderness and risk everything to escape alive.

Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

A fatal duel has just begun!

It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一場發生在三國動盪時期的史詩式之旅。曹操試圖招攬關羽加入他的陣營,但關羽忠於他的結拜兄弟劉備,也是曹操的敵人。當關羽試圖從曹操手上救出劉備的小妾時,迫於無奈要大開殺戒。最後他能否殺出重圍?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工阿文被安排潛伏於東南亞的軍火商旗下,尋找其手中的一批軍火炸藥並將其銷毀。當他終於找到該批軍火後,卻遭到不明匪徒襲擊。為防止災難發生,阿文決定與他的特工搭檔阿瓊合力奪回軍火。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode, the man with the world at his feet, Paulo Dybala. Arturo Vidal straightens the press out about rumours concerning him, and football gathers ever more fans in the United States.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Manchester United came back from the dead to win the Champions League in 1999. Here's how.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Stuttgart's Porsche Arena bouldering, usually a solitary pastime, becomes a sport, and Zurich, Switzerland, is our next destination for an event which celebrates free sports in multiple forms, FMX and mountain biking.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Stuttgart's Porsche Arena bouldering, usually a solitary pastime, becomes a sport, and Zurich, Switzerland, is our next destination for an event which celebrates free sports in multiple forms, FMX and mountain biking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Sporty Elegance
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 4-door coupes combine the best of two worlds, the performance of a coupe and the style of a limousine. We took a closer look at three examples of this car subspecies, the Audi A7, BMW's 4 Series Gran Coupe, and the Mercedes-Benz CLA models.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Fun Factor
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The top-of-the-line specimens of a car model range are built for pure driving pleasure. We put the VW Golf R, the Audi TTS and the BMW M 235i to the test in order to see if they are worthy of bearing the crown of their model range.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Coupes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British coupes are instant classics and just as cool as James Bond. Aston Martin, Bentley and Jaguar produce the most exclusive and elegant coupes in the world. Their distinctive design is still inspired by the iconic Jaguar E-Type and Aston Martin DB5.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Limousines
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British limousines are the embodiment of luxury, they are the automotive upper class. Built with the most exclusive materials, these limousines like the Rolls Royce Phantom, Bentley Mulsanne or Jaguar XJ combine luxury, comfort and power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Super Sports Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British super sports cars like the Aston Martin Vanquish, the Bentley Continental GT Speed or McLaren's P1 are among the most spectacular and beautiful sports cars in the world. It's not just about power but also grace and style.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - British Convertibles
epg.episode_synopsis_en: British convertibles like the Jaguar F-Type, the Aston Martin V8 Vantage or the Bentley Continental are elegant and sportier than many other cars. They enjoy cult status all over the world. After all, fast open-top two-seaters were invented in the UK.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Normal vs. Lifestyle SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The SUVs Nissan X-Trail and BMW X4 aren't typical offroaders. We witnessed the presentation of the new X-Trail model and BMW's premiere of their X4. Also: the Steinbeißer Trophy, where unusual offroad vehicles take part in a demanding rally.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - American SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the US, SUVs aren't usually considered just workhorses but rather treated as everyday vehicles. Americans don't want to miss out on space, comfort and loading capacity. We show you the Chevrolet Suburban, Jeep Cherokee and GMC Yukon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Racing fever
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The snowmobile race in Saalbach-Hinterglemm is the winter equivalent of the Formula 1. Also: at the Puma Race-Off Formula 1 driver Nico Rosberg invited footballer Sergio Aguero to a tour of the race track. And: Sebastian Vettel's cameo in a music video.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Animal-like Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Los Angeles, Dean Malay put the Hollywood appeal of the Volkswagen Beetle Convertible to the test. Also: at the BMW Design Night the Bavarian manufacturer showcased its newest creations. And: the Stuck brothers with the Lexus IS-F at the test track.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Moment of Force
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dennis Rostek races the Mathilda Racing GT-R1 at the Nürburgring Nordschleife. Also: the two sons of racing legend Hans-Joachim Stuck take the BMW 550d to the test track. And: could the Volkswagen Golf 7 be a suitable Bond car?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - City Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2015 Audi presented a facelift for their city racer A1. We put this compact to the test. Also: it's a tough competition in the compact class, and Renault and Peugeot also want a piece of the pie. We compared the Renault Twingo and the Peugeot 108.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Want Some More?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If you decide to purchase the Volkswagen Polo GTI or Citroen's DS4 SoChic you neither have to give up convenience nor performance. Also: Nissan doesn't hold back when it comes to their luxury brand Infiniti. We took the Q50 hybrid RWD to the test.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Flip through a cola truck
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stunt man Dominik Kowalski is an expert for falls, drops and body stunts. Today, everything will be different as he is supposed to be the stunt car driver. His objective is to do a flip through a cola truck.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Cannon
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes have a new car cannon in their equipment arsenal that accelerates a car in one second from zero to 70 km/h. The team tests the cannon after shooting a wild car chase on the autobahn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Ford Mustang
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Mini
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Tuned SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Small, strong, stylish
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Hans Herrmann
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the 1950s to 1970s Hans Herrmann came to fame as a successful Formula 1 and sportscar driver for manufacturers like Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Maserati who also won also the 24 Hours of Le Mans several times.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Sabine Schmitz
epg.episode_synopsis_en: People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Porsche Panamera
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2004 Porsche decided to build their Carrera GT in Leipzig and then to produce a four-door sedan in parallel to the Cayenne, the Porsche Panamera. Before this car can hit the streets, it needs to pass 71 stations in the production plant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - AMG
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The letters AMG stand for a company that meets the highest automotive standards. This tuning subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz develops vehicles that are in high demand, both on the streets and racing tracks alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Parking Wars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not only in the big cities it's a growing struggle for parking spots. . We took the BMW X6, the Citroen Cactus and the Smart forfour to town in order to find out how these cars would cope in this situation and surrounding.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cars with a rear-wheel drive are usually considered to be agile but also a bit capricious in regards to their handling. Does this also apply to the Porsche GT3 and the Smart? In addition: the sporty midsize sedan model range, BMW's 3 Series.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Drift, Fly & Fire
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes from the German company Action Concept really let it rip. This time stuntman Paul slides through under an exploding vehicle. At the same time gangster bride Anna flies through the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Salto Mortale
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Limousines
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it is the Mercedes S-Class, the BMW 7-series or the Audi A8, limousines „Made in Germany“ are considered status symbols, setting standards when it comes to comfort, pioneering technologies and safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Coupes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With their avantgarde design, superior technology and driving pleasure, German coupes like the Porsche 911, the Mercedes S-Class Coupe, the BMW 6-series or the Audi RS5 embody the passion for driving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Fascination offroad
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We test drove the Rallye Defender and examined how a Jeep Wrangler with only few modifications can double in price. Also: how does the Fiat Panda 4x4 fare in Iceland? Also: Land Rover's Bowler Defender and Volvo's 6-wheeler, the Laplander.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - All-Wheel Drive on snow
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We spent a day in snowy Austria with rally professional Niki Schelle in a Suzuki SX4 S-Cross. Also: why is the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution perfect for drifting? And: Mercedes and Chrysler present their all-wheel concept cars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Ferrari
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Super Sports Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it is the Porsche 918 Spyder, the Audi R8, the Mercedes AMG GT or the BMW i8 – German super sports cars are the fastest and most coveted in the world, with their breathtaking top speeds and incredible engine power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Autonomous driving
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autonomous driving is seen as the future of mobility. Assistance systems help drivers overtaking other cars, check if there’s another car in the driver’s blind spot or warn the driver to take a break when he shows signs of fatigue.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Parking Wars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not only in the big cities it's a growing struggle for parking spots. . We took the BMW X6, the Citroen Cactus and the Smart forfour to town in order to find out how these cars would cope in this situation and surrounding.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Rear-wheel drive for everyone
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cars with a rear-wheel drive are usually considered to be agile but also a bit capricious in regards to their handling. Does this also apply to the Porsche GT3 and the Smart? In addition: the sporty midsize sedan model range, BMW's 3 Series.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Drift, Fly & Fire
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes from the German company Action Concept really let it rip. This time stuntman Paul slides through under an exploding vehicle. At the same time gangster bride Anna flies through the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Salto Mortale
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Limousines
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it is the Mercedes S-Class, the BMW 7-series or the Audi A8, limousines „Made in Germany“ are considered status symbols, setting standards when it comes to comfort, pioneering technologies and safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Coupes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With their avantgarde design, superior technology and driving pleasure, German coupes like the Porsche 911, the Mercedes S-Class Coupe, the BMW 6-series or the Audi RS5 embody the passion for driving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Fascination offroad
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We test drove the Rallye Defender and examined how a Jeep Wrangler with only few modifications can double in price. Also: how does the Fiat Panda 4x4 fare in Iceland? Also: Land Rover's Bowler Defender and Volvo's 6-wheeler, the Laplander.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Fresh Air Experience
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Smart offers its iconic city car with a convertible option. The Mini cabriolet is bigger and provides room for four people. When it comes to roadster feeling, the Mazda MX-5 is on top of the list. We took a closer look at these three open-top contenders.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Drives of the Future
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Drives of the Future
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Drives of the Future
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Paris Motor Show features the automotive world of tomorrow. In 2016 Mercedes-Benz introduced their 'Generation EQ' and Volkswagen announced to build 20 new electrified models by 2020, possibly in order to distract from the emission scandal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Remote Control
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Graduate
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A vehicle jumps at full speed over four cars, which explode one after the other. It’s a matter of precision and timing for the Stunt Heroes. Also, up-and-coming stuntwoman Tina has to prove her skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Italian Coupes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They are the embodiment of a sportscar, the coupes by Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati and Alfa Romeo are breathtaking and irrisistible. Created by the most famous designers in the world, every Italian sportscar is a piece of art.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Rallye Fun
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - All-Wheel Drive on station wagons
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Skoda Octavia, the Opel Insignia Country Tourer, the Subaru Outback, the Audi S4 allroad quattro and the Seat Leon x-perience want to be more than roomy family cars. Their offroad features show that it doesn't always have to be an SUV.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - International SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Great Britain
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it’s Jaguar, Rolls Royce or Bentley, whether it’s Aston Martin or McLaren, whether it’s a luxury saloon, coupe or super sports car, these automotive creations from the UK combine tradition, luxury, performance and that unique British style.

epg.programme_title_en: Made In - BMW 5 Series GT, Part 1

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 08
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone heads to Mugello for Ferrari Challenge Europe, where Sergio Paulet and Michael Verhagen chase more wins. DTM also features as Kelvin van der Linde joins new BMW teammate Marco Wittmann for a light-hearted test of his BMW knowledge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Appearance and Reality
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What would make coupe fans opt for a more traditional two-door model like the Mercedes-Benz E400 instead of its bigger brother, the CLS with four doors? Also: does the Volkswagen Arteon stand a chance against the Mercedes CLS?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Convertibles
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We investigate the difference between the Porsche 718 Cayman GTS and the much more expensive 911 GTS. In addition: the third generation of the Mini as a convertible. And: roadster and cabriolet feeling with the facelift of Fiat's 124 Spider.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Very First Time
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - The Very First Time
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Very First Time
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The team is shooting a car rollover. Stunt coordinator Carl wants to go all out. He adds an exciting shootout to the mix. Also, he has a surprise for his boss. During the rollover he wants him to sit in the passenger seat, for the very first time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Highfall
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Stunt Heroes reveal how spectacular car stunts with big explosions are prepared and which tricks are pulled when you have to blow up a car or jump from a high-rise building.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Jaguar E-Type
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Jaguar E-Type is a century-old sports car whose look still quickens the pulse today. Those responsible at Jaguar waited almost 40 years before they dared to build a successor to one of the most beautiful cars in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Lamborghini
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The early history of sports car manufacturer Lamborghini was shaped by the rivalry between tractor manufacturer Ferruccio Lamborghini and Enzo Ferrari. Over the years, the brand launched some of the most striking sports cars in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Extreme offroad cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We present some of the more extreme specimens in the offroad world: a Fiat Panda monster truck, a Ford Raptor, a conversion of a Mercedes G-class Edition, a modified Volkswagen Touareg, a Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8 and the Fiat Panda Cross.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Luxury All Wheelers
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The luxury SUV Infiniti QX70 doesn't need to shy away from a comparison with the Porsche Panamera Turbo S. Also: the unveiling of the Land Rover Discovery Vision Concept in New York. And: test driving the Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI Terrain Tech.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Germany
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Whether it’s the Porsche 918 Spyder, the Mercedes S-Class, BMW's M6 or Audi's A8, premium cars from Germany are the benchmark when it comes to comfort, status, dynamics and driving pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Italy
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italy is the land of fashion, design and the most exciting cars of the world. Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati and Alfa Romeo are considered the epitomes for breathtaking cars, designed with stunning shapes, vivacious engines and incomparable passion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Trailerstunt
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝過昆士蘭東南地區,在繁殖與捕蛇的季節逐步升溫時,觀看阿黛兒與米克迎戰一條東部棕蛇,這是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同時史都與麗芙則與一條地毯蟒糾纏搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭,飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中.與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the worlds rarest crocodile.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊.也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗.見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園.這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bonaires fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse m...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中.與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the worlds rarest crocodile.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊.也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗.見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​隨著春季的蛇潮展開,跟隨麗芙與史都一起,他們在工地現場攔截兩條為爭奪交配權而決鬥的公棕蛇,這是一場激烈的爭鬥,一場關乎交配資格的爭戰.退後站觀,觀看丹與潔絲從一條蟒蛇手中救出雞群,而米克與阿黛兒則追捕一條失控的綠樹蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Launch into springs snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中.與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息.觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛羅里達群島是美國南部的第一道防線.憑藉豐富的海軍歷史和沿海生活方式,不難相信當地人聲稱那是多達1000艘沉船殘骸的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, its easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊.也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息.觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛羅里達群島是美國南部的第一道防線.憑藉豐富的海軍歷史和沿海生活方式,不難相信當地人聲稱那是多達1000艘沉船殘骸的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, its easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中.與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭於昆士蘭沿海的混亂景象與喧囂之中,傑絲勇敢面對她內心的恐懼,追逐一隻攀爬至樹上的蕾絲蜥蜴,而那棵樹上還棲息著活躍繁忙的蜂巢.觀看斯圖小心翼翼地將一條被困在籬笆之間的東方褐蛇救出,並觀察米克為驚慌不安的屋主捕捉那條滑溜難抓,靈活的巨蟒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Weave through Queenslands coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣.觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣.牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大.在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴哈馬被稱為水底電影世界的首都.荷里活已經到訪這裡幾十年了,在水晶般清澈的水底製作史詩式的電影和電視戲劇節目,其中的大熱景點包括許多電影般的沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bahamas is known as the underwater movie capital of the world. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾與豹同行,跟隨這些自然界的偽裝大師,隱沒於斯里蘭卡的叢林之中.深入了解這種強大的貓科獵手,如何完美適應島上炎熱乾燥的氣候,並學習牠們的追蹤和獵食技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潛入狹小緊迫的空間之中,鑽入溫室的底部結構,並進入緊張刺激的救援現場,捕蛇人勇敢面對一條長達六英尺,極度有毒的褐蛇.隨後觀看斯圖與莉芙將威脅到屋主寵物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬遷至安全地點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowners pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​發現歐洲最佳建築如何為一些大陸上最稀有的物種創造庇護所.前往法國,蘇格蘭和西班牙,在那裡,海豹,鳥類,蠑螈,野貓和蛇類在水邊的古老地標之間茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how Europes best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continents rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在歐洲最壯觀的山峰之中見證動物的戲劇.造訪羅馬尼亞和法國的中世紀城堡,那裡的熊,猞猁和獵鷹正在復甦,然後看看在比利牛斯山中巧妙適應氣候變化的岩蜥蜴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness animal drama among Europes most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard thats cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的三大貓科動物:獅子,花豹和獵豹雖然並肩而居,但他們各自發展出專門的狩獵策略,以避免彼此衝突.深入了解這些頂級獵食者的生活和故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Though Africas three big cats-the lion, leopard, and cheetah-live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線.牠們成年的過程需要技巧,力量,勇氣和大量的運氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索美麗的海德堡城堡,它的廢墟屹立在德國西部的內卡河旁.這座城堡位於受保護的自然保育區中,是猛禽的家園,亦是附近兩棲類的產卵場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往擁有數百年歷史的法國堡壘,它是史上一些最偉大帝國的家園.卡爾卡松曾是財富和文化的中心,如今已成為野生動物的避難所.鳥類,野豬和昆蟲大軍在其豐裕的環境中生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of historys greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 發掘刻在洞穴裡世上最大的城堡.斯洛文尼亞的洞窟城堡不僅為中世紀的人類居民提供了保護,而且還為該區的鳥類,野豬和野山羊提供了避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the worlds largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊覽西班牙格林納達地區一生必到的非凡堡壘- 阿爾罕布拉宮.這個世界文化遺產現在成了該地區野生動植物的庇護所.它擁有眾多溪流和噴泉,可供應兩棲類,魚類和鳥類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spains Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the regions wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解世上最壯觀的建築之一 - 新天鵝堡及其周邊的森林如何成為許多生物的家園.從阿爾卑斯羱羊到雄偉的天鵝,這座城堡於數世紀以來成了天然避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how one of the worlds most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

epg.programme_title_tc: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界.動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與鯊魚一起在海中潛行,看他們使用高度敏銳的感官和殺手的本能進行捕獵.觀看白頂礁鯊利用其電子傳感器探測心跳來尋找獵物,以及淺海長尾鯊用其鞭狀的尾巴來擊暈獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與那些在藍色的虛空中繁衍生息的流浪鯊魚一起領略海洋的廣闊,深邃與黑暗.見識穿越大西洋風暴的海域的孤獨藍鯊,以及返回太平洋島嶼繁殖地的數百條雙髻鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨一群具有非凡能力的鯊魚,牠們可以在全球最惡劣的環境中繁衍生息.觀察在冰冷的北極水域生活,但幾乎失明的格林蘭鯊,以及另外一種能在陸地行走的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸附近,新生的座頭鯨吸了牠的第一口氣.牠身長16呎,是一個巨人,但未來的挑戰跟牠一樣巨大.在進行地球上最長的遷徙之一前,牠必須快點長大.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whales life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著松鼠猴的繁殖季節臨近,女強人艾巴必須帶領牠的團伙尋找食物,但男領袖撒母耳能奪得芳心嗎?年輕的沙奇拿迷了路,而敵人逐漸緊逼,局勢開始緊張.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where its mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進.然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群.最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜.在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼.並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuletas loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描繪獅子生命的九個階段,從無助的小獅子到自信的成年獅,再到年老的流亡者.看看競爭,飢餓和驕傲的動態如何塑造它在塞倫蓋提的生活,並見證使這種社交貓獨特的忠誠和合作精神.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與一隻小小的幼獅一起在森林中穿行,觀看年輕的成年獅如何宣示自己的領土,並見證年老獵人的不可避免的流亡.發現本能和潛行如何幫助老虎在它孤獨的世界中生存,在這裡每一個決定都充滿風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進.然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群.最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩.
