epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限:潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Dubai, Luke goes all out with adrenaline-packed dives, jetpacking thrills, golf swings, and speedboat races—then shares Potter memories over dinner…the loser picks up the tab!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Poland, Sophie trades a calm weekend for a rush of adventure: trekking the towering Tatras, rafting wild rivers, uncovering a legendary salt mine, and so much more!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom—plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000台風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計、生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在伊斯坦堡,詹姆斯和奧利弗於加拉達塔與娜塔莉·提娜會合.他們橫渡博斯普魯斯海峽,乘坐東方快車列車穿過雪山體驗雪地摩托車,並在市場品嚐土耳其美食、果油餅(Baklava)與異國香料.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Istanbul, James and Oliver meet Natalie Tena at Galata Tower. They cross the Bosphorus, ride the Eastern Express train through snowy mountains for ski-dooing, and sample Turkish cuisine, baklava, and exotic spices at the market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄弟在坦帕的伊博爾城遇見了阿爾菲·艾倫.他們在最古老的古巴餐廳用餐、與坦帕灣閃電隊打冰球、打棒球、享用在地海鮮與啤酒,並探訪這座城市最著名的鬧鬼飯店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampas Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德里格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊、體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園、品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyns determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Phelps twins meet Alfie Allen in Tampas Ybor City. They eat at the oldest Cuban restaurant, play ice hockey with the Tampa Bay Lightning, play baseball, enjoy local seafood and brews, and visit the citys most haunted hotels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利聖地牙哥與熱妮西斯·羅德里格茲會面後,詹姆斯和奧利弗參觀了青金石工作坊、體驗馬戲團,並學習了庫埃卡舞(Cueca).他們還遊覽了壯麗的葡萄園、品嚐頂級葡萄酒,並親手製作傳統恩潘納達餅(Empanadas).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Genesis Rodriguez in Santiago, Chile, James and Oliver visit a Lapis Lazuli workshop, experience a circus, and learn the Cueca dance. They also tour stunning vineyards, sample fine wines, and cook traditional empanadas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called bubble feeding to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoos bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, Its a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom—plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決、傳統舞蹈、《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽、池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計、生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客、一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. Theres room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯——這位年輕執行長是「相對論太空公司」的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the worlds first 3D printed rocket.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德獲得前所未有的機會,進入全球最神祕的藝術作品之一——詹姆斯.特瑞爾的〈羅登火山口〉.在這座火山口中,藝術以光與宇宙為題展開探索.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the worlds most guarded artworks: James Turrells Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪.貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化.歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omars FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, hell create a boot inspired by ARCH.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igors company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利——她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.programme_title_tc: 摩根費里曼:不可思議的生涯
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入探索摩根・費里曼的人生旅程——從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through the life of Morgan Freeman—his struggles, triumphs, and legendary voice that shaped Hollywood and beyond.

epg.programme_title_en: Celine Dion: The Heart Goes On
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳.狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華.然而,她的人生並非一帆風順.跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事——從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celine Dion is a household name, synonymous with musical brilliance. Yet, her life has not been untouched by hardship. Join us as we uncover the story behind the legend, her meteoric rise to fame, and the personal trials that shaped her remarkable ca

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alans rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisies getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape—whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限:潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Dubai, Luke goes all out with adrenaline-packed dives, jetpacking thrills, golf swings, and speedboat races—then shares Potter memories over dinner…the loser picks up the tab!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Poland, Sophie trades a calm weekend for a rush of adventure: trekking the towering Tatras, rafting wild rivers, uncovering a legendary salt mine, and so much more!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom—plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決、傳統舞蹈、《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽、池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥.這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover world-renowned, well-preserved biotopes and meet iconic endemic species—macaws, hummingbirds, condors, and marine iguanas. Formed millions of years ago, these species now face growing threats from deforestation and climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥.這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover world-renowned, well-preserved biotopes and meet iconic endemic species—macaws, hummingbirds, condors, and marine iguanas. Formed millions of years ago, these species now face growing threats from deforestation and climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugals diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugals coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness how Americas South and Midwest were ravaged by 148 twisters in just 18 hours.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoos bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, Its a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugals coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾.阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師.隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igors company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬.布拉德利——她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達.透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂.羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員.馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 詹姆斯和奧利弗與斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅.途經法國葡萄園與瑞士阿爾卑斯山,他們學習鐘錶製造、征服險峻的富爾卡隘口,最終在科莫湖上以輕鬆的遊船之旅結束行程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver set off on a road trip to Lake Como with Stan Ianevski. Passing through French vineyards and the Swiss Alps, they learn watchmaking, navigate the dangerous Furka Pass, and end with a relaxing boat ride on Lake Como.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞,雙胞胎與馬修·路易斯於蓬塔阿雷納斯會合.他們徒步前往百內塔基地營、回憶《哈利波特》的拍攝點滴、跟隨當地牧民(Baqueanos)學習趕羊與騎馬,並利用夜視攝影機捕捉野生美洲獅的蹤影.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Patagonia, the twins join Matthew Lewis in Punta Arenas. They hike to Base Las Torres, reminisce about Harry Potter, learn sheep herding and horseback riding with Baqueanos, and spot a wild puma using a night-vision camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝里斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址、走訪水洞、了解門諾會文化、巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食、飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索年輕的諾瑪珍.在展現才華和膽色的同時,她拋開艱辛的童年,以「瑪麗蓮夢露」的身份進入荷里活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as Marilyn Monroe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyns defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyns determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥.這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover world-renowned, well-preserved biotopes and meet iconic endemic species—macaws, hummingbirds, condors, and marine iguanas. Formed millions of years ago, these species now face growing threats from deforestation and climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索舉世聞名且保存完好的生物群落,親眼見證標誌性的特有物種——金剛鸚鵡、蜂鳥、安地斯神鷹以及海鬣蜥.這些經過數百萬年演化形成的物種,如今正面臨著森林砍伐與氣候變遷帶來的日益嚴峻之威脅.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭、翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩、侏儒象、長鼻猴、犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deep dive into Borneos heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客、一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. Theres room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison dêtre. The police forces special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000台風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公里的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibias wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖、亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. Its a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽、池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」.他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪之旅,準備新鮮的壽司,並前往妻子家鄉沉醉一些家鄉滋味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary tour of Japan, preparing fresh sushi and taking a trip to his wifes hometown to indulge in a little home cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌、名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了「工薪族」的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science. A single tooth shook the scientific community. The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution. Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits. On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace. As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be.

Join us, as Discover China visits Old Town Lijiang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: No one could have dreamed that from this baby boy, born to a noble family on a financial and social decline, would grow one of China's most influential, iconic and important historical figures. From his early days, mimicking the religious rituals, to a young man who traveled throughout China, advising kings and emperors on how to rule, the man ultimately became a living legend, as his teachings and his memory are still revered and worshipped to this day in modern China. Discover China follows in the footsteps of one of China's most important cultural heroes, Confucius.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science. A single tooth shook the scientific community. The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution. Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits. On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace. As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.

epg.programme_title_en: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman. Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers. Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture. This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Covering five years of conflict, Cries from Syria serves as a record of Syria's brutal disintegration and the dangers faced by its many refugees. Incorporating gripping first-hand accounts from activists, child protesters, and a former army general who joined the uprising, this compelling documentary bears witness to the resilience of the people in the wake of their exposure to unthinkable crimes against humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to). Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family. Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Today nuclear subs dominate the seas…yet their biggest threat is a diesel submarine. The modern diesel submarine is capable of a wide range of capabilities and it is known for its incredible stealth. We learn more about why they are so lethal in the dark depths of the Norwegian Fiords while on a NATO exercise inside a modern diesel submarine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It is the fastest growing Christian church on earth and here The Holy Spirit truly flows. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries. Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped. Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect. Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
epg.programme_title_en: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman. Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers. Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture. This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cobra Kai gains its second student. Daniel has an intricate plan to get payback on Johnny. Miguel defends Samantha against Kyler during lunch break.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼的道場課吸引一群不合的人,而他心懷不軌的兒子羅比則找到一份新工作.薩曼莎在科學課上結識一位新朋友.丹尼爾激發了一個意想不到的人對空手道的興趣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnnys dojo class attracts a group of misfits while his son Robby, who harbors ulterior motives, lands a new job. Samantha makes a new friend in science class. Daniel inspires interest in karate from an unlikely person.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼得知眼鏡蛇道場被禁止參加全谷錦標賽後跟市議會對質.米格爾約會薩曼莎.羅比向丹尼爾學習,而他的夥伴則策劃搶劫拉魯索汽車公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Johnny learns Cobra Kai is banned from the All Valley Tournament, he faces the City Council. Miguel asks Samantha out. Robbie takes lessons from Daniel, just as his buddies plot a heist from LaRusso Auto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼為他的眼鏡蛇道場學生準備下一屆全谷空手道錦標賽,他也反過來受啟發去改過自新.丹尼爾還不知道他新學生的背景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny prepares his Cobra Kai students for the next All Valley Karate Tournament and in turn, he is inspired to clean up his life. Daniel is still unaware of his new pupils background.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事.眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復.米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Louies reckless actions forces Johnny and Daniel to go down memory lane. The Cobra Kai students plot revenge against the popular kids. Miguel grows impatient with Samantha.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the day of the 2018 All Valley Karate Tournament and Cobra Kai is determined to win. Robbie signs up unaffiliated. A familiar face from the past returns.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel makes another attempt to promote Miyagi Do, and receives guidance in a familiar form. Johnny grows suspicious about Kreese’s backstory. A new Cobra Kai student challenges Miguel and befriends Aisha, while Robby revisits a past he’d rather forg

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾努力幫助新生學習.米格爾交了新友,而強尼則嘗試修復一段關係.兩個道場之間的張力已達到臨界點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel struggles to help a new student learn. Miguel makes a new connection, while Johnny tries to repair a relationship. Tensions between the two dojos build to a breaking point.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾的學生們上了如何克服怨恨的一課.強尼離開道場一段時間,而克里斯則發揮他的影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel’s students are given a lesson in overcoming their grudges. Johnny spends some time away from the dojo, while Kreese exerts his influence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了讓學生們做好準備,丹尼爾嘗試一些新的訓練方法.米格爾活學活用.強尼做出一個影響眼鏡蛇道場既艱難但關鍵的決定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To prepare his students, Daniel gives some new training methods a shot. Miguel puts a new lesson into practice. Johnny makes a tough but pivotal decision that affects Cobra Kai.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾努力與阿曼達修補關係,而強尼則打開約會應用程式的大門.米格爾,薩曼莎,羅比和朵利的相遇讓事情變得複雜起來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel works to make amends with Amanda, while Johnny is introduced to the world of dating apps. Complications arise when Miguel, Samantha, Robby and Tory cross paths.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼小心翼翼地嘗試不大會成功的戀愛,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則享受浪漫的約會夜.嘗試讓兩個道場的學生聚會卻適得其反,青少年間的敵意不斷升級.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny cautiously takes a stab at love, while Daniel and Amanda enjoy a romantic date night. An attempt to bring the students of the two dojos together backfires as hostilities between the teens escalate.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s the first day of school at West Valley High but tensions between the two dojos have not cooled with the end of summer. And the rivalry between Daniel and Johnny comes to a head.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米格爾命懸一線,羅比失蹤.丹尼爾與強尼名譽掃地,社區仍為西谷高中大亂鬥的後續動盪不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Miguels fighting for his life, Robbys missing, and Daniel and Johnnys reputations are in tatters as the community reacts to the West Valley brawl.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾與強尼放下成見,聯手尋找羅比.米格爾的康復之路充滿未知,克里斯試圖召回托莉重返道館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel and Johnny team up to find Robby. Miguel faces an uncertain future. Kreese tries to bring Tory back to Cobra Kai.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾的事業因形象受損而陷入低潮,並收到收購提議;強尼四處籌錢,為米格爾的手術奔走.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniels tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguels surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一艘捕鯨船的唯一倖存者,講述船長為了追捕那頭白鯨莫比·迪克而陷入自我毀滅的執念與悲劇故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sole survivor of a lost whaling ship relates the tale of his captains self-destructive obsession to hunt the white whale, Moby Dick.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一艘捕鯨船的唯一倖存者,講述船長為了追捕那頭白鯨莫比·迪克而陷入自我毀滅的執念與悲劇故事.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pop-singer Chipmunks Alvin, Simon and Theodore turn a songwriters life upside-down.

epg.programme_title_tc: 奪寶大戰:尋找命運之矛的探險
epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Quest For The Spear
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名書蟲成了新的圖書館員.就在同一晚,一支具有魔力的長槍被盜,他因此踏上環遊世界的實戰冒險旅程,尋回長槍--旅程的第一步,就是被他那可愛的助手從飛機上扔到亞馬遜雨林上空.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在魔鬼孩子王中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子.這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作,幽默和感人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, it’s a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在回到未來 III中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士.這部影片充滿了笑話,動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s the first day of school at West Valley High but tensions between the two dojos have not cooled with the end of summer. And the rivalry between Daniel and Johnny comes to a head.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米格爾命懸一線,羅比失蹤.丹尼爾與強尼名譽掃地,社區仍為西谷高中大亂鬥的後續動盪不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Miguels fighting for his life, Robbys missing, and Daniel and Johnnys reputations are in tatters as the community reacts to the West Valley brawl.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾與強尼放下成見,聯手尋找羅比.米格爾的康復之路充滿未知,克里斯試圖召回托莉重返道館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel and Johnny team up to find Robby. Miguel faces an uncertain future. Kreese tries to bring Tory back to Cobra Kai.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾的事業因形象受損而陷入低潮,並收到收購提議;強尼四處籌錢,為米格爾的手術奔走.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniels tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguels surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾前往日本洽談重要會議,重回沖繩,尋找能讓事業與人生重回正軌的啟示.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following an important meeting in Japan, Daniel revisits Mr. Miyagis hometown in Okinawa. Johnny attempts to reconnect with Robby.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Okinawa, Daniel spends time with an old friend - and an old enemy, who has much to teach him. The dueling dojos rivalry comes to a nasty head.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanitys future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著最新一起怪獸目擊事件在營地中蔓延,西蒙試圖警告他的朋友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Simon tries to warn his friends as the latest beast sighting spreads terror across the camps.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: My plan worked. With this declaration, Endorsi kicks her own teammate.\nWhat was the true intention of her plan to gather all the Fishermen in one location and see how the Ranker would act?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蕾切爾身負重傷. 她將如何面對與巴姆的重逢? 當他們各自的思緒和意圖交織在一起時,每個人都做出了各自的決定,繼續前行. 悲傷過後,等待著他們的又是什麼?
epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Rachel suffers a grave wound.
How will she feel about reuniting with Bam?
As their various thoughts and intentions jumble together, each one reaches their own decision in order to move forward.
What waits for them beyond their sadness?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當博士正享受著又一個寧靜的下午,悠閒地喝著咖啡時,突然被一隻觸手怪拉進了地下水道.這隻地下水系統的怪物名叫魔鬼魚克拉肯,它剛好酷愛咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Doc is enjoying another peaceful afternoon drinking coffee, hes suddenly pulled underground through a manhole by a tentacled beast. This monster of the underground water system is know as the Devil Fish Kraken, and it just happens to love coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯的魔法力量迅速增強,但他已經習慣了這種力量,以至於使用起來變得粗糙不堪.為了給他一個教訓,雅加強迫塞斯戴上能阻止他使用魔法的手套,並警告他如果摘下手套就會被開除.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth has rapidly gained more magical power, but hes gotten so used to it that his handling has grown sloppy. To teach him a lesson, Yaga forces Seth to wear gloves that prevent magic use and says that if he removes them, hell be expelled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名新加入審判庭的成員注意到德拉古諾夫隊長的態度似乎相當漫不經心,他不明白為何手下對他如此信任.他加入審判庭的初衷是想與危險的巫師戰鬥,而不是處理一些雜務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A new recruit in the Inquisition notices that Captain Dragunovs attitude seems quite careless, and he cant understand why his men have such faith in him. He joined the Inquisition hoping to fight dangerous sorcerers, not handle odd jobs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名工作狂父親在工作時遇到致命的煤氣爆炸,並體驗了消防員的英勇後,決心改變他生命中的優先次序.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A work-obsessed father changes his priorities after facing a deadly gas explosion at work and experiences the heroic efforts of fire fighters

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰艦世紀中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋,天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥.由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜,泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當暴力升級時,拉爾夫挺身而出,然後驚恐地意識到,輪到他成為獵物了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ralph jumps into action when violence escalates, then realises with horror that it is his turn to be hunted.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪洛莉和謝拉聯手尋找科普劍,這是唯一可以阻止穆加華夫的武器.西門和卡拉亞庇不惜一切地試圖拯救穆加華夫讓他們負責的龍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mallory and Jared team up to find the Vorpal Sword, the only weapon that can stop Mulgarath. Simon and Calliope get desperate trying to save the dragons Mulgarath put them in charge of.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆加華夫將謝拉囚禁在麥士瓦奇,決心找出龍之書的位置.謝拉在食人魔之中遇上對手,成為被操縱的受害者.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another test is held to reach the top of the tower.\nMuch has been lost and important things have been gained in order to climb the tower.\nAccept it all and move forward in the direction your feelings lead you.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its been a month since Seth parted ways with Alma. A festival is about to be held in Artemis Academy, and Seth is excited by the joyous atmosphere.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 博士接到一項與復仇女神有關的任務.他起初拒絕了,但賽斯決心要追捕復仇女神,於是替他接受了任務.就這樣,賽斯,梅莉和博士啟程前往轟鳴之城──一座如雷鳴般咆哮的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Doc has received a request to handle a job involving a Nemesis. He rejects it at first, but Seth is determined to go after the Nemesis and accepts the job for him. Thus Seth, Melie, and Doc depart for Rumble Town, the city that roars like thunder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在回到未來 III中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士.這部影片充滿了笑話,動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, its the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大學畢業後,布莉琪急切需要一份工作來支持她的寫作生涯,並成為大亨安東尼哥斯的行政助理.她很快瞭解到奢華的生活要付出致命的代價.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After graduating from college, Bridget desperately needs a job to supposrt her writing career and becomes an EA to tycoon Anthony Gloss She soon learns that a life of luxury comes at a deadly price

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵巫師大軍襲擊艾肯尼村,一場生存之旅正式開展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A journey of survival begins when an army of Witchfinders attacks the village of Alkenny.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Abandoning her serving job at a fancy wedding, Charlie vows to clear the name of a friend caught in a compromising position.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查理在為時已晚前急忙警告被臭名昭彰殺手盯上的目標,過程中讓她對所相信的一切產生懷疑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Charlie questions everything she believes in as she races to warn the target of a notorious killer before its too late.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵巫師大軍襲擊艾肯尼村,一場生存之旅正式開展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A journey of survival begins when an army of Witchfinders attacks the village of Alkenny.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆加華夫將謝拉囚禁在麥士瓦奇,決心找出龍之書的位置.謝拉在食人魔之中遇上對手,成為被操縱的受害者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulgarath holds Jared captive in Meskwaki, determined to find the location of the dragon page. Jared has met his match in the ogre, falling victim to his manipulation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝拉,西門和瑪洛莉必須和解,才能將海倫和漢臣的所有人從穆加華夫貪婪的胃口中拯救出來.謝拉學會接受自身的缺點,並將其化作力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jared, Simon and Mallory must reconcile to save Helen and all of Henson from Mulgaraths insatiable appetite. Jared learns to accept his flaws and see them as strengths.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了登上塔頂,又一次考驗擺在眼前. 為了攀登這座塔,我們失去了很多,也獲得了重要的東西. 接受這一切,跟隨你內心的指引繼續前進.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another test is held to reach the top of the tower.\nMuch has been lost and important things have been gained in order to climb the tower.\nAccept it all and move forward in the direction your feelings lead you.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 各種各樣的想法和意圖在混亂的最終試煉場上交織在一起. 在巨大的陰謀擺佈下,戰士們勇敢地在戰場上奔跑. 當試煉達到高潮時,巴姆會向蕾切爾展現出怎樣的決心?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All manner of thoughts and intentions intersect at the chaotic final testing ground.\nWhile tossed about by a giant plot, the combatants boldly race across the battlefield.\nAs the test reaches its climax, what resolve will Bam show to Rachel?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 博士接到一項與復仇女神有關的任務.他起初拒絕了,但賽斯決心要追捕復仇女神,於是替他接受了任務.就這樣,賽斯,梅莉和博士啟程前往轟鳴之城──一座如雷鳴般咆哮的城市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Doc has received a request to handle a job involving a Nemesis. He rejects it at first, but Seth is determined to go after the Nemesis and accepts the job for him. Thus Seth, Melie, and Doc depart for Rumble Town, the city that roars like thunder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞思,梅莉和醫生前往貧民窟,拜訪了發出任務請求的人居住的房子.這家人請求調查,因為他們的長子泰吉已被感染,但他們的求助卻被宗教裁判所置之不理.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth, Melie, and Doc visit the house in the slums where the one who sent the job request lives. The family requested an investigation because their eldest son, Taj, has been infected, but their pleas for help are ignored by the Inquisition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宗教裁判所的康拉德隊長說服了隆隆鎮的居民,鎮上的事故都是移民和巫師造成的.憤怒和恐懼驅使鎮民發動起義,要求消滅所有感染者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Konrad of the Inquisition convinces the people of Rumble Town that the accidents there have been caused by immigrants and sorcerers. Fueled by anger and fear, the towns residents lead an uprising, demanding the elimination of all infected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個魔法息微,科技盛行的世界裡,15歲的珍妮花史傳奇經營著一家魔術師招聘公司,並發現最後一條龍正被獵殺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a world where magic is waning and technology prevails, 15-year-old Jennifer Strange runs a magician employment agency and discovers the last dragon is being hunted.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanitys future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰艦世紀中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋,天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥.由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜,泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After graduating from college, Bridget desperately needs a job to supposrt her writing career and becomes an EA to tycoon Anthony Gloss She soon learns that a life of luxury comes at a deadly price

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Established in Year 2004, Creation TV has produced a lot of quality programs and delivers the message of happy-life Joy with God to families via our television broadcast. Programs are edited and produced as the tools for evangelists and life education.

epg.programme_title_tc: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Established in Year 2004, Creation TV has produced a lot of quality programs and delivers the message of happy-life Joy with God to families via our television broadcast. Programs are edited and produced as the tools for evangelists and life education.

epg.programme_title_tc: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基督之家第五家 講題:一個也不忘記  人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 情人節將至，悅相約朋到戲院看戲，朋爽快答應會購票。二人回到飯廳，看到義與花在大曬恩愛，義即取笑沒有愛侶的情。與此同時，亨帶麗到高級餐廳進膳，可惜麗卻不解溫柔，強拉亨到大拍檔用餐，亨一怒而去。
有德繼續憶述與無雙再相遇後相戀的過程，可惜本欲私奔的兩人最終被孫遜棒打鴛鴦。孫母見如今有德已分家，不想女兒再遭李家害命，決定成全兩人。昭和長公主因玉樓相救，請旨要嫁他，玉樓沒有拒絕，更寫下休書給少春。

epg.programme_title_tc: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Forthright Securities Presents:Inside The Stock Exchange[Can] and Pop Lifestyle Guide (Ad Mag)[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 坐月期間，需要補充維他命及營養素。牛奶魚有豐富的維他命D及DHA，可惜魚骨太多，用來煲湯就最好；鱈魚有豐富蛋白質、維他命A、B、D，簡單用南瓜、芋絲鋪底蒸熟，便成滋補好餸！肥媽用糯米、南棗、桂圓以文火煲出甜粥，另一邊又用鮮淮山、紅棗、鵪鶉做出焗飯。期間肥媽大爆其子入產房見證生產的所見所聞，嚇壞六號！肥媽精選「豬板根」這個部位，連同鮮百合及蘆筍做出小炒，六號竟主動搶走鑊鏟，說要展示功架！

epg.programme_title_tc: 才駿HASHTAG 科技新指標[粵]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 身體隨年紀如對外在環境適應力減弱，引起抵抗力、復原力的問題，導致未能應府日常生活，就可能是患上「衰弱症」，老人科醫生提醒要留意老友記可有出現五大警號！而飲食太清淡、過度照顧竟是加速衰弱的元兇？邵德龍師傅帶隊往佐敦隱世「車胎人推介」潮州私房菜館，品嚐正宗潮菜原味道。潮州人老闆兼大廚做腸粉起家，先來碟鮮蠔腸粉；眾人再吃傳統小食炸粿肉與蠔餅，主食還有連皮牛肉煲！「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「老菜甫醋薑炒飯」。
經婚姻中介找對象，卻墮入照騙陷阱，能否控告公司違反「商品說明條例」？大家或曾聽聞有人怕被分身家，要求簽婚前協議，但在香港可有法律約束力？祖儀、韵芝接連持相反意見，引發「熱議」。妻子撞破丈夫玩Cyber Sex，能以通姦為由申請離婚嗎？嘉賓方力申本認定等同出軌，但當森美搬出成人影片作例子，即想轉軚……討論到偷偷安裝追蹤App可涉犯法，森美笑稱是關乎全港男士「安危」！律師解說個案，還帶來應對絕招……

epg.programme_title_tc: 才駿HASHTAG 科技新指標[粵]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軟飯王訓練班導師邀利亞致畢業詞，利亞分享經歷並勸各人不要像他，更帶領眾男接受戒除食軟飯的毒癮，且替他們重組債務。靜雯懷孕後身體常感不適，容材與費柴故意讓靜雯看到拉美吻在野。芭芭拉派飯盒給露宿者時看見尤田，想拉尤田回家但被拒。尤田患感冒，病榻中想到要向在野報仇。公開活動上，拉美向靜雯表示已與在野在一起，尤田突然持刀出現割傷自己的手指，與在場多人同時暈倒。尤田在醫院醒來，照顧他的醫護人員卻暈倒。

epg.programme_title_tc: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵] 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Forthright Securities Presents:Inside The Stock Exchange[Can] and Forthright Securities Presents:Trading Edge[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小丸子不滿媽媽調校的泡澡水溫，決定要親自動手，聽爸爸說有「搓水」的做法，於是去尋找工具。秋天來臨，遍地銀杏葉，小丸子帶著爺爺和一班同學去幫佐佐木掃落葉，聽對方說關於銀杏的知識。
這集有新到來的曲奇與薯片小兵，接受零食廠廠長蚌蚌公主的考驗。眾人在「廠長話」熱身賽中顯得有些手忙腳亂，但當踏入淘汰賽，其中一隊即時調整狀態，成功全員過關，並贏得零食秘笈。要透過神奇地壺「收集」指定食材，雖然兩隊都未能完成任務，大家的努力仍獲廠長嘉許。攻略「溶化之橋」，曲奇小兵團團長提醒拿着六個雪糕球的隊員不要心急前進，怎料話音未落就已失誤？某薯片小兵挑戰相同數目的雪糕球，運送其間不停自我鼓勵……
紅精靈要求細菌人把呠呠妹妹帶回來一起玩。但當找到呠呠妹妹時，細菌人發現很怕的秋葵妹妹也在一起。飯團人因為細菌人的襲擊，而意外跌到山下的並暈倒。幸而得到被池沼仔發現了，並保護他免被雨淋。
緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 睡食症是一種發生在睡眠期間的異常行為，病人會在半夢半醒、無意識的狀態下進食，甚至吃下生肉等食物，醒來後往往對過程毫無記憶。此症常見由傳統安眠藥引起，因此對於長期或大量服用安眠藥的病人、長者及曾有病史的人士而言，有睡食症的機率會相對較高。患者亦會因常在夜間無意識進食、煮食而引致危險及導致體重上升。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 節目錄影期間意外頻生，眾女直指是無雙從中作梗，無雙否認並當眾力證清白，更因此受傷；子盈舊愛李德龍也注意到事件。眾女探訪無雙時，透露都收到子盈署名的神秘信封。綺雲憶起七年前舊事，子盈獲雲生重用，她則屈居子盈之下。綺雲於拍攝時誤傷子盈，令子盈被換角，其實綺雲早察覺道具槍有異樣；事後，綺雲向雲生自薦，從此開啟成為天誠一姐之路。無雙與雲生在綺雲拍攝現場商討合作事宜，鳳儀自覺像陪襯。綺雲拍攝時，竟發生意外！

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 內地食店容易購入新鮮乳鴿，而香港餐廳受限於冰鮮貨，這先天差異可會左右這趟乳鴿菜餚評級的結果？廣州珠江新城的星級名店，捨棄主流的紅燒做法，改以鹽焗烹調乳鴿。不過，四隻鴿腿索價破百元，有名廚公開乳鴿來貨價，反映CP值甚低；另一名廚甚至以港式快餐店炸雞作比喻。香港代表則大玩中西融合，廚師將法式嫩煎鴿胸搭配炸釀鴿髀，帶來一鴿二食。現場評審大多給予高分肯定，但嘉賓森美敏銳點出，某細項的評分偏低，有何見解？
徐慧與李泰結盟，承乾則被迫在皇位與稱心之間選擇。世民與魏徵步步施壓，承乾最終揮劍，似乎親手處決摯愛。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 顧井昏迷後，殘生感內疚，遂變賣觀音手，替顧井床上換上絲綢，又買人蔘給顧井補身，忠正懷疑顧井被殘生所害，於是拿走殘生家中之玉器粉末給玉麟鑑定，後更假扮買家引殘生入甕，惜被殘生走脫。忠正再設計令殘生不打自招，承認一直利用忠正及顧井作報復棋子。殘生欲殺忠正滅口，混亂間推跌油燈，火勢蔓延，忠正吃力地將昏迷的顧井拖出屋外，殘生一聲慘叫，令顧井甦醒，即衝入火場，卻欲救無從，殘生被活活燒死。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

身體隨年紀如對外在環境適應力減弱，引起抵抗力、復原力的問題，導致未能應府日常生活，就可能是患上「衰弱症」，老人科醫生提醒要留意老友記可有出現五大警號！而飲食太清淡、過度照顧竟是加速衰弱的元兇？邵德龍師傅帶隊往佐敦隱世「車胎人推介」潮州私房菜館，品嚐正宗潮菜原味道。潮州人老闆兼大廚做腸粉起家，先來碟鮮蠔腸粉；眾人再吃傳統小食炸粿肉與蠔餅，主食還有連皮牛肉煲！「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「老菜甫醋薑炒飯」。
經婚姻中介找對象，卻墮入照騙陷阱，能否控告公司違反「商品說明條例」？大家或曾聽聞有人怕被分身家，要求簽婚前協議，但在香港可有法律約束力？祖儀、韵芝接連持相反意見，引發「熱議」。妻子撞破丈夫玩Cyber Sex，能以通姦為由申請離婚嗎？嘉賓方力申本認定等同出軌，但當森美搬出成人影片作例子，即想轉軚……討論到偷偷安裝追蹤App可涉犯法，森美笑稱是關乎全港男士「安危」！律師解說個案，還帶來應對絕招……
軟飯王訓練班導師邀利亞致畢業詞，利亞分享經歷並勸各人不要像他，更帶領眾男接受戒除食軟飯的毒癮，且替他們重組債務。靜雯懷孕後身體常感不適，容材與費柴故意讓靜雯看到拉美吻在野。芭芭拉派飯盒給露宿者時看見尤田，想拉尤田回家但被拒。尤田患感冒，病榻中想到要向在野報仇。公開活動上，拉美向靜雯表示已與在野在一起，尤田突然持刀出現割傷自己的手指，與在場多人同時暈倒。尤田在醫院醒來，照顧他的醫護人員卻暈倒。
情人節將至，悅相約朋到戲院看戲，朋爽快答應會購票。二人回到飯廳，看到義與花在大曬恩愛，義即取笑沒有愛侶的情。與此同時，亨帶麗到高級餐廳進膳，可惜麗卻不解溫柔，強拉亨到大拍檔用餐，亨一怒而去。
有德繼續憶述與無雙再相遇後相戀的過程，可惜本欲私奔的兩人最終被孫遜棒打鴛鴦。孫母見如今有德已分家，不想女兒再遭李家害命，決定成全兩人。昭和長公主因玉樓相救，請旨要嫁他，玉樓沒有拒絕，更寫下休書給少春。

今集指定菜式「荔枝鴨胸配印度薄餅」，步驟不繁複，黎諾懿、鄭俊弘、何廣沛該不用擔心太多吧！有美女為搶分怪招盡出，行「跌膊」政策是否奏效？誠實地說出鴨胸未熟透，誠意能打動評判嗎？自選菜式主題為示愛餐，一隻斑馬瀨尿蝦，有美女一斬便流失蝦膏精華，自取滅亡！另外兩位用鹹蛋炒、鹽焗烹煮，好味到阿Bob連蝦殼都食埋，振朗則不停問二女是否單身。地獄菜式換來負評不斷，唯獨何廣沛給予無限高的分數，難道這美女示愛成功？

玉樓巧妙打消長公主出嫁念頭，接少春回府。出嫁多年的玉樓三姐孫有容突然回孫府，穿金戴銀，好不氣派。家中女眷聽說可以跟著有容做生意，紛紛心動，唯有少春瞧出破綻。少春暗中施以援手，終於讓要強的有容吐露實情。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肥媽購入的食材大多都是紅色及黑色，難道坐月補身也要講顏色？紅麴米可活血去瘀，連同洋薏米、蓮子、香菇、雞腿肉一起煲飯，要它帶點香甜，重點在哪裏？平時煲蓮藕章魚湯會加綠豆，為何今次肥媽改用紅豆？用淡豆豉、竹絲蛋簡易地炒出滑蛋，對要餵母乳的產婦有莫大幫助！產婦需補血補鐵，肥媽用高鐵質的紅莧菜、金針花分別煮成「紅莧菜甘筍芝士餅」及「金針雲耳紅棗炒鴕鳥肉」，讓坐月餸菜味道不再單一清淡。

阿茲海默症是腦部疾病，會影響記憶力、判斷力或執行能力，此症也有中年患者，並可能與基因有關。老人科醫生細說診治方法，傳統藥物能緩解症狀，現時亦有新藥可有效減低腦內不正常物質的積聚。初中學生周語露接受多項檢查後，得知患癌卻樂觀面對，治療期間對低音大提琴提起興趣，康復後隨即找導師學習。導師憶述對語露的初印象，還大讚她的陽光思想！兩人更即席合作二重奏，展現琴藝。「睇餸食飯」，鄭錦富師傅炮製「家鄉釀藕餅」。

乘客以硬幣支付近百元車資，的士司機拒收兼爆粗。嘉賓麥美恩談論上述兩項行為時邏輯欠奉，森美笑言她會被「浸豬籠」！電單車司機熄匙推車過交通燈，美恩直指違法卻將「偷雞」講成「偷窺」，令人摸不着頭腦……想知的士乘客把大件行李帶入車廂可需支付行李費，必先了解「輕便手提行李」的尺寸指引。此外，彥妤獲律師稱讚提問好，一洗「亂問問題」污名！星爺飾演的士司機，向攜帶一箱雞仔的婦人逐隻收費一幕夠經典，但現實中可行嗎？
(大結局)網上流傳病菌煮熟也殺不死，又可由皮膚接觸感染，全城恐慌。Professor Robort表示，多人暈倒的怪病源頭是鯊魚，稱之為魚流感。保健中心免費提供按摩服務，讓顧客保持心平氣和抗病；郭寶替麗敏父親按摩，垃圾卿提議他把握機會提親。在野質問拉美為何陷害自己，拉美說出當年恩仇，又帶尤田找靜雯，令靜雯受感染。尤田在夢中遇見變成了天使的鯊魚Shirley，才知自己作惡的因由……

花式跳繩的種類越來越多，表演與比賽場地有時還會移師至商場，讓這項運動的接觸層面更廣闊。「Kids’ Notes」請來兩位跳繩女教練，細談接觸花式跳繩的經過，以及教導小朋友的心得。兩人也分別是中國香港跳繩代表隊隊長及成員，若比賽時稍有失誤，心態與策略上又如何即時作出調整？花式跳繩也設有團體項目，但與人合作少不免有意見不合的時候，嘉賓認為與其爭吵，倒不如收拾情緒，先着重如何解決問題，來得更實際！
陶俑仔獲得花公主邀請到訪花樂園。細菌人知道之後，設法令陶俑仔無法前往，並且假扮他前往花樂園搗亂。榴槤公主知道睡衣人會贈送睡衣給人之後，為了得到睡衣而希望與睡衣人見面。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 圓圓與朱基原來關係非比尋常，她決絕裝作不認識，更要朱基保持距離……「開心小棧」樓上開了撞名按摩店，令該處龍蛇混雜。龔喜本想到健身室鍛鍊身體，得悉安多勳與多位教練在小棧為圓圓特訓，往湊熱鬧卻誤闖按摩店，惹來麻煩。冠一得知圓圓與多位猛男共聚，遂到小棧一探究竟；得悉真相後，他不甘被一眾壯男比下去，也來「展示實力」卻大出洋相。其後，圓圓遭嫖客糾纏，獲朱基解圍。冠一趁機說服圓圓搬家，朱基懷疑箇中另有內情……

epg.programme_title_tc: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#3[粵][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 無雙憶起子盈與德龍發展地下情，子盈意外懷孕後隱瞞真相，獨自誕下女兒莊寶兒。綺雲腳部重傷，驚悉無雙已取代自己成了女主角。綺雲據理力爭，請求雲生主持公道……何氏集團公子何家俊與雜誌社總編楊素希重逢，一見如故；原來是無雙暗中指使素希，以破壞菲雅與家俊的婚姻。寶兒暫回香港，與德龍因聯手制伏劫匪而結識。素希依計行事，不久便令家俊迷戀上自己，並向她傾訴對菲雅以及這段婚姻的不滿。菲雅看到德龍賣車，心裡戚然……

epg.programme_title_tc: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 港、陸乳鴿比拼，持續升溫。本港名店率先以經典紅燒口味出擊，主廚不藏私分享酥脆外皮的炸製關鍵；其品質之高，連嘉賓森美外帶品嚐時，鴿皮依然香脆有驚喜。公佈餐廳的GBA指數評級，想不到「回頭率」細項是最高評分！鏡頭一轉來到佛山南海的工業區，工廠舊飯堂搖身變成網紅名店，主打沙薑鹽焗乳鴿。有名廚略感嘆此做法「埋沒」乳鴿；鼎爺則更推薦鴿肉飯。但也有吃遍全入圍名單四十間店的評審力撐，盛讚這店是他的心中最愛。
徐慧與李泰結盟，承乾則被迫在皇位與稱心之間選擇。世民與魏徵步步施壓，承乾最終揮劍，似乎親手處決摯愛。

epg.programme_title_tc: 娛樂頭條[粵] 及 環球新聞檔案[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。
報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

epg.programme_title_en: Nong's Shen Ling Bai Shu San Pres:Weather Report[Can] and Pop Lifestyle Guide (Ad Mag)[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朝庭公佈玉麟等人三日後問斬，忠正揭力挽救。處斬當日，顧井與九斤二欲途中劫囚，卻不成功，幸忠正教眾人分辨銅錢藏金方法，他的一番肺腑之言，令眾人紛紛拿出銅錢，玉麟等才可釋放。寶兒過不慣窮人生活，顧井看在眼裡，不惜千金買來燕窩及絲綢來令她高興。守言欲重出江湖，卻被人刁難，忠正拔刀相助，守言雖對忠正刮目相看，玉麟對他卻越感痛恨。守言偷聽到玉麟曾遭忠正輕薄，遂找余實算賬，更設局令余實知道忠正乃大騙子一名。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

阿茲海默症是腦部疾病，會影響記憶力、判斷力或執行能力，此症也有中年患者，並可能與基因有關。老人科醫生細說診治方法，傳統藥物能緩解症狀，現時亦有新藥可有效減低腦內不正常物質的積聚。初中學生周語露接受多項檢查後，得知患癌卻樂觀面對，治療期間對低音大提琴提起興趣，康復後隨即找導師學習。導師憶述對語露的初印象，還大讚她的陽光思想！兩人更即席合作二重奏，展現琴藝。「睇餸食飯」，鄭錦富師傅炮製「家鄉釀藕餅」。

乘客以硬幣支付近百元車資，的士司機拒收兼爆粗。嘉賓麥美恩談論上述兩項行為時邏輯欠奉，森美笑言她會被「浸豬籠」！電單車司機熄匙推車過交通燈，美恩直指違法卻將「偷雞」講成「偷窺」，令人摸不着頭腦……想知的士乘客把大件行李帶入車廂可需支付行李費，必先了解「輕便手提行李」的尺寸指引。此外，彥妤獲律師稱讚提問好，一洗「亂問問題」污名！星爺飾演的士司機，向攜帶一箱雞仔的婦人逐隻收費一幕夠經典，但現實中可行嗎？
(大結局)網上流傳病菌煮熟也殺不死，又可由皮膚接觸感染，全城恐慌。Professor Robort表示，多人暈倒的怪病源頭是鯊魚，稱之為魚流感。保健中心免費提供按摩服務，讓顧客保持心平氣和抗病；郭寶替麗敏父親按摩，垃圾卿提議他把握機會提親。在野質問拉美為何陷害自己，拉美說出當年恩仇，又帶尤田找靜雯，令靜雯受感染。尤田在夢中遇見變成了天使的鯊魚Shirley，才知自己作惡的因由……
三妗婆要高家眾人協助趕製過年吃的蘿蔔糕，朋無奈答應。完成後，朋準備不眠不休地進行大掃除，突發現遺失了結婚戒指！朋懷疑戒指已混入蘿蔔糕餡料中，可惜大部分蘿蔔糕已分發給親友。朋與溢立即進行「回收行動」。
玉樓巧妙打消長公主出嫁念頭，接少春回府。出嫁多年的玉樓三姐孫有容突然回孫府，穿金戴銀，好不氣派。家中女眷聽說可以跟著有容做生意，紛紛心動，唯有少春瞧出破綻。少春暗中施以援手，終於讓要強的有容吐露實情。

吳業坤、張振朗、李綺雯、小寶在前輩兼評判胡楓和羅蘭面前鬥演技，爭取各回合「最好戲」評級。四位在「我係大話精」都疑似坐在雪糕筒（路障）的尖端，當中一人其實安坐圓櫈，修哥與羅蘭姐能否看出誰最「四平八穩」？一眾嘉賓同場合演即興劇，童星鄭耀軒「喊功」出色！「超級遙控戲」環節，期間坤哥為了慶祝求婚成功，需「定鏡」抱起斤両十足的小寶，「戲力」與臂力同受考驗！「另類好戲王」請出「闊太王」女演員展示「貴氣」演技。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 慶發起在社區中心千叟宴，惜因食物供應商被查封，不能提供食物，慶將事情揹於身上，高家會總動員幫忙。可是慶回到家中，欲提出此事時，眾人卻因要準備過年物件，根本沒有人理會慶。結果，只有麗及亨答應幫忙。
孫金閣搗騰一些玩意竟發生爆炸，玉樓和哥哥詳談之下發現金閣是有遠大抱負的人；少春趁機把金閣推薦給皇上；孫遜發現少春懷有東鮫珠，一問之下才知是柳三絕給她的，勾起了孫遜的一段青春回憶。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對肥媽而言，十人大餐零難度，先煮其中四道菜及一個湯。加入紅菜頭烹煮的羅宋湯，有甚麼特別益處？肥媽示範用椰菜花剁碎，務求做出西瓜pizza以外的另一經典！六號請纓用手拍青瓜，配合簡易的汁料，演繹製作「手拍黃瓜」的容易度。肥媽動手把花龍蝦開邊，讓牠變身為美味的「芝士香草龍蝦」宴客菜。一塊優質安格斯肉眼扒，為何肥媽不塗橄欖油而用芥花籽油？煎扒時與觀眾溫故知新，重提冷藏牛扒處理重點。
《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。
打工仔關心勞工法律問題，笑稱是「無良僱主」的林盛斌也來一解疑惑。親戚來港旅遊卻在家人的餐廳義務工作，老闆可有犯法？至於僱員在家工作時被燙傷，Bob直言僱主不用負法律責任，韵芝以澳洲個案反駁其觀點。老闆向遲到員工扣薪，撥入「下午茶福利」，認為合法的Bob再次未獲女神們支持，結果如何？若介紹客戶到夜總會進行性交易但沒收取報酬，可屬違法？祖儀笑言「金牌媒人」Bob的撮合行為與個案性質相近，惹眾人爆笑！

epg.programme_title_en: The Learning Curve Of A Warlord#1[Can][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大元帥狄奇來到昇威鎮，鎮民與鄰近三個地方大帥李細龜、麥先根、佘南一同恭候。大帥府內，狄奇與兄弟馬炭、羅義、冬來吃着鮑參翅肚，憶起戰場上分吃蟑螂的經歷。革命黨員章沅婉以笛聲引來狄奇，伺機刺殺他惜事敗，狄奇竟輕易放了她及其同黨。翌晨，真的大元帥蒙大同來到，怒責狄奇放了革命黨，四兄弟被囚。冬來成功帶眾人逃獄，惜馬炭中槍。狄奇明白自己只是大同的替身，決定返大帥府取回應得的；另一邊廂，沅婉喬裝進入大同壽宴。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 媽媽叫小丸子提早寫賀年咭，小丸子心生一計，便是親手送出賀年咭，然後私吞郵費。老人會年尾表演話劇，爺爺本來飾演配角森石松，卻因主角演員受傷而變成飾演次郎長，小丸子為他進行特訓。
這回「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，兒童體適能教練將會指導主持姐姐與三位小朋友，挑戰一連串平衡力，以及協調能力的訓練。這些鍛練不但有助刺激肌肉和骨骼發育，而且對提升日常運動表現大有幫助。首先利用豆袋、雪糕筒等輔助道具強化平衡力，還有以單腳站立的動作，大家要穩定控制身體重心。稍作休息過後，教練又指導眾人在敏捷梯上練習雙腳進出、逐格開合跳、側向爬行等動作，大家表現如何？
公主與史納樂隊奮力消滅邪音魔軍團，可是凱蘿卻讓邪音魔以更快速度增生。經過一番苦惱，奈津想到她能夠做的事，就是透過直播，向世人呼籲做自己喜歡的事。這種快樂與熱愛，正是音樂之力的泉源。
緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 公關女皇唐萬里獨力照顧Gen Z女兒唐芯，控制欲極強。萬里的母親唐曹嘉冰半生相夫教子，忽然「覺醒」，由加拿大返港，決心尋回失落時光，更搬入萬里家中。當年嘉冰曾因萬里堅持未婚生下女兒，母女徹底鬧僵，如今嘉冰卻突然無預警殺入及擾亂萬里的生活。萬里力圖維持秩序，唐芯則周旋兩人之間，三代同堂火花四濺，矛盾不斷。職場上，富二代老闆空降「營銷大神」楊帆，與萬里平起平坐正面交鋒，萬里事業與家庭同時迎來危機……

epg.programme_title_tc: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#4[粵][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德龍從無雙處取回子盈之物，並回想與子盈的甜蜜往昔。菲雅在過去已情傾德龍，當年得知德龍與子盈在一起時，竟藉拍戲公報私仇。未幾，子盈便陷入醜聞風波。子盈即使醜聞纏身，仍獲雲生包容，惹來鳳儀妒忌……雲生打算全力推動串流平台計劃，鳳儀傾力協助，向無雙明言無暇抽身拍攝《玫瑰》，並指綺雲、菲雅亦已推辭，無雙心下一沉……雲生欲拉攏何氏基金合作，卻遭主席何永康奚落，無雙深信此事必能促使雲生加速開拍《玫瑰》。

epg.programme_title_tc: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人[粵]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蝦餃展現點心師傅的極致手藝，「皮餡摺蒸」步驟統統甚為講究，平民小店、星級食府都有創意用心之作。銅鑼灣的新派點心店以中西合璧做法，奉上破格的黑金蝦餃，評審們卻認為墨魚汁皮反而令經典美食不再晶瑩通透，黑松露亦遮蓋了蝦的鮮味，有所扣分？澳門某酒店中菜館以金魚為主題，將蝦餃升呢藝術品。栩栩如生的「金魚餃」，用上清甜爽脆的刺身級藍天使蝦，味道與賣相兼備！有名廚見證金魚餃的「進化」，並形容是千錘百鍊的成果。
太子妃發現稱心未死，徐慧設計讓世民撞破真相。世民親赴邙山殺死稱心；李泰與韋妃則計劃把蕭薔難產嫁禍媚娘。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 余實為彌補忠正輕薄玉麟一事，決定讓忠正入贅守言家，並使忠正及玉麟米巳成炊，兩人卻不肯就範。二老假裝病入膏肓，才令二人勉強應允。成婚當天，忠正受盡淩辱才可進門，巳感氣結，於是命顧井將所有禮金收起，用作私房錢，但顧井卻被寶兒將禮金全數騙去，忠正雖惱顧井，但兄弟一場，遂原諒了顧井。忠正與玉麟自成婚後，經常勢不兩立，卻又要在兩老面前扮恩愛，雙方均感疲累。布政大人找忠正鑑證罕有的女兒紅，玉麟得悉後大表驚慌。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。
《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。
打工仔關心勞工法律問題，笑稱是「無良僱主」的林盛斌也來一解疑惑。親戚來港旅遊卻在家人的餐廳義務工作，老闆可有犯法？至於僱員在家工作時被燙傷，Bob直言僱主不用負法律責任，韵芝以澳洲個案反駁其觀點。老闆向遲到員工扣薪，撥入「下午茶福利」，認為合法的Bob再次未獲女神們支持，結果如何？若介紹客戶到夜總會進行性交易但沒收取報酬，可屬違法？祖儀笑言「金牌媒人」Bob的撮合行為與個案性質相近，惹眾人爆笑！

epg.programme_title_en: The Learning Curve Of A Warlord#1[Can][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大元帥狄奇來到昇威鎮，鎮民與鄰近三個地方大帥李細龜、麥先根、佘南一同恭候。大帥府內，狄奇與兄弟馬炭、羅義、冬來吃着鮑參翅肚，憶起戰場上分吃蟑螂的經歷。革命黨員章沅婉以笛聲引來狄奇，伺機刺殺他惜事敗，狄奇竟輕易放了她及其同黨。翌晨，真的大元帥蒙大同來到，怒責狄奇放了革命黨，四兄弟被囚。冬來成功帶眾人逃獄，惜馬炭中槍。狄奇明白自己只是大同的替身，決定返大帥府取回應得的；另一邊廂，沅婉喬裝進入大同壽宴。
慶發起在社區中心千叟宴，惜因食物供應商被查封，不能提供食物，慶將事情揹於身上，高家會總動員幫忙。可是慶回到家中，欲提出此事時，眾人卻因要準備過年物件，根本沒有人理會慶。結果，只有麗及亨答應幫忙。
孫金閣搗騰一些玩意竟發生爆炸，玉樓和哥哥詳談之下發現金閣是有遠大抱負的人；少春趁機把金閣推薦給皇上；孫遜發現少春懷有東鮫珠，一問之下才知是柳三絕給她的，勾起了孫遜的一段青春回憶。

「星夢」歌手同門較量，周柏豪夥拍連詩雅，對戰謝東閔與戴祖儀。日本拉麵文化博大精深，主打魚介湯底的拉麵店內多個虹吸式咖啡壺，有甚麼作用？雜貨店內每件商品僅得一件，卻非二手貨物，兩隊須猜出店舖貨源。泰式按摩花款多多，一款條狀物件有何另類用途？冰島一場所因擺放「神聖之物」，吸引不少充滿好奇心的旅客；兩隊競猜箇中「最大」與「最小」，Do姐見眾人一臉蠢相，大方給予貼士！哪一隊能獲幸運之神眷顧，贏得高額獎金？

賈逢源跟梁京冠謀劃扳倒孫遜，決定先除掉孫貴妃。他利用潘才人喪子之事大做文章，找來李太醫指證是孫貴妃令大皇子感染瘟疫而死。林少春為孫貴妃打抱不平，提出疑點，皇上批准召李太醫家人進宮，同時下旨包圍孫府。

KOL為吸Like，在社交平台舉辦抽獎活動。嘉賓吳業坤本認為犯法，卻想起自己也曾派福利送贈簽名相，慌忙要轉軚！一時錯手將淫褻影片發放到通訊軟件群組，可會觸犯法例？坤哥「衰多口」，令祖儀火起要「動武」。錄取偶像演出片段進行二次創作，並於網上發佈。眾人只着眼於侵犯版權事宜，到律師解答時方知是涉及私隱條例。坤哥諗到頭痛，更笑言想中途離場……部份店舖會將疑似小偷的截圖張貼出來，以警惕公眾，此舉卻可能違法？

epg.programme_title_en: The Learning Curve Of A Warlord#2[Can][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沅婉欲刺殺大同之際，有人搶先一步叛變，狄奇四人助大同擺平叛軍。大同怒斥狄奇逃獄後竟敢回來偷竊，狄奇蘭花巧舌下仍難平其怒氣，四人作好被殺準備。怎料大同宣布讓狄奇接管昇威鎮，並將沅婉、艾妞、葉天嬌給他作姨太太，還送上愛犬少帥。鎮長裘千差帶狄奇巡鎮，狄奇替鎮民處理紛爭的方法，讓鎮民哭笑不得。細龜三人分別邀請狄奇一聚，趁機給他下馬威，狄奇一一擺平，並反過來宴請三人。三人威嚇狄奇，狄奇二話不說開槍殺人。
